title: General Manager- Human Resources
description:
**Position Overview**

The General Manager – Human Resources will play a strategic leadership role in driving the organization’s human capital agenda and aligning HR initiatives with overall business objectives. The role demands a dynamic HR leader capable of managing complete HR functions across multiple dealership locations while ensuring operational excellence, employee engagement, statutory compliance, organizational development, and business growth support.

The incumbent will act as a business partner to the management team and departmental heads by developing people strategies, strengthening organizational culture, enhancing workforce productivity, and implementing progressive HR systems and practices.

The role requires strong exposure to automobile dealership operations including Sales, Service, Spare Parts, Body Shop, CRM, Administration, and Support Functions.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

Strategic HR Leadership

* Develop and implement long\-term HR strategies aligned with organizational goals and business expansion plans.
* Partner with senior management in organizational planning, workforce optimization, and succession planning.
* Drive transformation initiatives and strengthen HR systems, policies, and organizational effectiveness.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, productivity, discipline, and employee development.
* Contribute towards organizational growth through innovative HR practices and people\-centric initiatives.

Manpower Planning \& Talent Acquisition

* Prepare annual manpower budgets and departmental manpower planning strategies.
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment activities for all levels including frontline staff, middle management, and leadership roles.
* Develop talent pipelines for critical positions and future business expansion.
* Ensure timely hiring of quality manpower within approved budgets and timelines.
* Coordinate with consultants, job portals, institutes, and internal references for talent acquisition.
* Strengthen employer branding initiatives to attract and retain high\-performing employees.

HR Operations \& Process Management

* Oversee complete HR operations including attendance management, leave administration, payroll coordination, employee documentation, and HRMS management.
* Ensure proper implementation of HR policies, SOPs, systems, and employee lifecycle management processes.
* Monitor employee confirmations, promotions, transfers, increments, disciplinary actions, and separations.
* Ensure maintenance of employee records, statutory registers, and HR documentation as per compliance requirements.
* Drive process standardization and digital HR initiatives across all branches.

Performance Management System (PMS)

* Design and implement performance appraisal systems linked with business KPIs and organizational goals.
* Monitor departmental productivity and employee performance indicators.
* Support management in performance reviews, career progression planning, and succession development.
* Facilitate performance improvement plans for underperforming employees.
* Promote merit\-based performance culture and recognition systems.

Employee Engagement \& Organizational Culture

* Develop employee engagement initiatives to improve morale, motivation, and retention.
* Foster positive employee relations and maintain a healthy work environment.
* Address employee grievances professionally and ensure timely resolution of concerns.
* Organize employee welfare activities, celebrations, reward programs, and communication forums.
* Promote company values, discipline, teamwork, and ethical work culture across all departments.

Learning \& Development

* Identify training needs through performance reviews and operational requirements.
* Design and coordinate technical, behavioral, leadership, and customer service training programs.
* Develop second\-line leadership and internal talent development programs.
* Coordinate with OEM trainers and external training agencies for skill enhancement initiatives.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and ensure continuous employee development.

Statutory Compliance \& Legal Management

* Ensure complete compliance with all applicable labor laws and statutory regulations.
* Monitor PF, ESI, PT, Bonus, Gratuity, CLRA, POSH, Minimum Wages, Shops \& Establishment Act, and other legal compliances.
* Coordinate with labor consultants, auditors, and government authorities during inspections and audits.
* Ensure timely submission of statutory returns and maintenance of statutory records.
* Handle legal cases, employee disputes, disciplinary proceedings, and domestic enquiries whenever required.

Industrial Relations

* Maintain harmonious industrial relations across dealership operations.
* Handle employee disciplinary matters, counseling sessions, warning procedures, and conflict resolution.
* Ensure effective communication between management and employees.
* Support management in handling labor\-related issues and workforce discipline.
* Develop proactive employee relation strategies to minimize attrition and disputes.

HR Analytics \& MIS Reporting

* Prepare HR dashboards, analytical reports, and management MIS for decision\-making.
* Monitor key HR metrics including attrition, absenteeism, productivity, hiring efficiency, and employee engagement.
* Provide strategic insights and recommendations to management based on HR data analysis.
* Ensure accuracy and confidentiality of HR reports and employee information.

Administration \& Support Functions

* Support administration\-related activities including facility management, security coordination, housekeeping monitoring, and employee welfare infrastructure.
* Coordinate corporate communication and internal administrative functions.
* Ensure smooth coordination between HR and operational departments.

**Educational Qualification**

* MBA / MSW / PGDM in Human Resources Management.
* Additional qualification in Labour Law / Industrial Relations preferred.

Experience Required

* 15–20 years of overall HR experience.
* Minimum 5–7 years in senior HR leadership role within Automobile Dealership or Automotive Industry.
* Experience in multi\-location dealership operations will be preferred.

**Desired Competencies \& Skills**

* Strong leadership and people management abilities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Expertise in recruitment, performance management, employee engagement, and HR operations.
* Ability to handle complex employee relations and organizational challenges.
* Strategic thinking with strong analytical and decision\-making capabilities.
* High level of integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Have you managed statutory compliance and labour law matters independently?
* Have you handled HR operations for multiple branches/locations?
* Years of experience in automobile dealership or automotive industry ?
* Notice Period
* What is your current \& expected salary?

title: Senior Solutions Consultant
description:
**What is this role?**

You sit with clients and help them figure out what they actually need. Sometimes before they buy, sometimes after. You are not pitching. You are thinking alongside them.

A client walks in confused, or worse, confident about the wrong thing. Your job is to slow that down, ask the right questions, lay out two or three real options with honest trade\-offs, and then recommend the one that makes financial sense. You explain the ROI in their language \-\- not "faster hiring" but "you will save X lakhs per quarter by cutting time\-to\-fill by 12 days."

That is the whole job. Do that well and everything else follows.

**Why does this role exist?**

MyNextHire has been in the enterprise ATS space for 10 years. We work with some of the best companies in the country. The world is shifting to AI\-first hiring, and our clients need someone who can help them think through that transition clearly. Not someone who demos features. Someone who consults.

**How this role fits inside the company**

You are not working alone. For new clients, the sales team brings you in once there is a real conversation to be had. Your job is not to find the deal \-\- it is to shape the deal so the client buys the right thing for the right reasons. If you believe the client is not ready for something, you say so. That credibility is what makes the relationship last.

For existing clients, the CX team handles day\-to\-day operations and pulls you in when something needs deeper thinking \-\- a workflow redesign, an AI adoption conversation, a stakeholder who needs convincing. The CX team coordinates the daily work. You own the client relationship and you own the renewal outcome. If a client does not renew, that is on you.

So the rhythm looks like this: sales brings you the new conversations, CX brings you the existing ones, and in both cases you are the person in the room doing the thinking that shapes what happens next.

**What will you actually do?**

At full capacity, you will own 20 enterprise client relationships. Ten are existing clients you will guide through their AI\-first hiring transformation with MyNextHire. Ten are new clients you will onboard from scratch, joining early in pre\-sales and staying through implementation until they are running independently.

In the first 90 days, you will sit in on real client conversations across both groups. You will spot where the client's stated problem and their real problem are two different things. You will take one stuck situation and build a proper options\-and\-ROI recommendation for it.

Once you are up to speed, you become the person clients ask for when things are complicated, ambiguous, or politically tricky. Because they know you will give them a straight answer, not a sales answer.

**How we will measure success**

Two numbers matter in year one.

First: 70% of your clients should be actively operating in AI\-first hiring workflows within 12 months. Not just aware of the features. Actually using them to change how they hire.

Second: 100% of your clients should have been through at least one structured business impact review where they clearly understand the value MyNextHire is delivering. No client should reach renewal wondering whether this was worth it.

If those two numbers land, everything else \-\- renewals, expansion, referrals \-\- follows naturally.

**Where might you be coming from?**

Management consulting:

especially if you worked on HR or operations projects. You already know how to structure messy problems under pressure.

Customer success or implementation at an HR tech company:

You have been solving problems post\-sale for years and you are tired of being reactive. You want in on the earlier, meatier conversations.

In\-house TA, especially if you led an ATS rollout or a big process change:

You know the buyer's world from the inside. You want to go from running the system to advising others.

On domain knowledge: we will teach you the product, the workflows, and the enterprise TA landscape. We have 10 years of depth to draw from and we are good at transferring it. But you have to be the kind of person who is genuinely hungry to learn a new domain from scratch, asks questions constantly, and does not wait to be taught. If you are someone who picks things up fast because you are curious, not because you are told to, you will be fine.

**How will we interview you?**

We will throw you a messy problem you have never seen before and watch how you break it apart. No case prep. No right answer. We just want to see how your mind works.

We will ask what makes you angry about bad client work. If your answer is specific and opinionated, good. If it is vague and safe, that tells us something too.

At some point we will disagree with you on purpose. We want to see if you fold, get defensive, or actually engage with the pushback. The third one is what we are hiring for.

**Who should not apply?**

If your resume is full of calls\-per\-day and leads\-per\-week numbers, this is not the role. If your last few jobs were pure transactional sales or delivery at a large IT services company with no advisory work, probably not the right fit. If you have never pushed back on a client or a manager in your career, you will struggle here.

**One last thing**

The test for this role is simple. At the end of year one, 70% of your clients should be hiring differently than they were before they met you. That is not a metaphor. That is the job.

description:
**Company Description**  

In India, Bosch is a leading supplier of technology and services in the areas of Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. Additionally, Bosch has in India the largest development center outside Germany, for end\-to\-end engineering and technology solutions. The Bosch Group operates in India through twelve companies: Bosch Limited – the flagship company of the Bosch Group in India – Bosch Chassis Systems India Private Limited, Bosch Rexroth (India) Private Limited, Bosch Global Software Technologies, Bosch Automotive Electronics India Private Limited, Bosch Electrical Drives India Private Limited, BSH Home Appliances Private Limited, ETAS Automotive India Private Limited, Robert Bosch Automotive Steering Private Limited, Automobility Services and Solutions Private Limited, Newtech Filter India Private Limited and Mivin Engg.Technologies Private Limited. In India, Bosch set\-up its manufacturing operation in 1951, which has grown over the years to include 16 manufacturing sites, and seven development and application centers. The Bosch Group in India employs over 30,500 associates and generated consolidated sales of about Rs. 26,827 crores (3\.1 billion euros) in fiscal year 2021\-22 of which Rs. 24,406 crores (2\.8 billion euros) are from consolidated sales to third parties. Bosch Limited is the flagship company of the Bosch Group. It earned revenue of over Rs. 11,782 crores (1\.39 billion euros) in fiscal year 2021\-22\.  

Additional information can be accessed at www.bosch.in

**Jaipur Plant** is the fourth manufacturing Plant, set\-up in India in the year 1999\. We are a Powertrain Solutions (PS) Plant which is **known for it's operational excellence**. Our **safety standards** are a **benchmark across RO\-IN**, which has won us several awards \& accolades by Govt. of Rajasthan. We are a **team on energetic people who believe in agility \& inclusiveness, open \& transparent communication across various levels of organization are our USP**.


We are a **Lead Plant for two products**, namely; **VE Pump (Diesel Fuel Injection Pump) and Nozzle Holder Assembly** (both are diesel intrinsic components).


We take pride in mentioning that Bosch in India a **Great Place to Work** **certified Company**.

 **Job Description** **Key Responsibilities**

* **Regulatory Compliance**
	+ Ensure adherence to local, national EHS \& ESG regulations (e.g., BRSR, CSRD , Environment protection rules , Factories Act \& Rules, PESO , FIRE Licenses) and CPCB’s EPR requirements .
	+ Monitor updates to environmental and safety laws and implement necessary changes in company policies.
	+ Conduct audits and inspections to ensure compliance with EHS standards.
* **Risk Assessment and Incident Management**
	+ Identify potential environmental, health, and safety hazards through risk assessments.
	+ Investigate workplace incidents, near misses, and accidents to determine root causes and implement corrective actions.
	+ Develop emergency response plans and conduct regular drills.
* **Sustainability Initiatives**
	+ Lead sustainability projects focusing on waste reduction, energy efficiency, and emissions control.
	+ Implement EPR strategies by designing eco\-friendly products and packaging that align with recycling and disposal requirements.
	+ Collaborate with R\&D teams to innovate sustainable materials or processes.
* **Training and Awareness**
	+ Develop training programs for employees on EHS practices, sustainability goals, and compliance requirements.
	+ Foster a culture of safety and environmental responsibility across the organization.
* **Program Development**
	+ Establish EHS management systems (e.g., ISO 14001 \& ISO 45001 ) to ensure continuous improvement in environmental performance.
	+ Develop safety programs that include ergonomic assessments, machine guarding protocols, and chemical management.
* **Monitoring and Reporting**
	+ Track key performance indicators (KPIs) for safety incidents, energy usage, waste management, water management etc.
	+ Prepare detailed reports for internal stakeholders and regulatory authorities.
	+ Use digital tools to monitor environmental impact metrics like emissions or waste.
* **Collaboration**
	+ Work closely with cross\-functional teams such as engineering, operations, procurement, and HR to integrate EHS into daily activities.
	+ Liaise with external consultants or regulatory bodies for guidance on compliance or project execution.

  

**Qualifications** **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/ Chemical/Environmental/Fire and Safety preferred).
* Diploma in Safety \& certification in safety management (e.g., NEBOSH or equivalent).
* Experience with ISO certifications like ISO 14001 (Environmental Management) or ISO 45001 (Occupational Health \& Safety).
* Familiarity with digital tools for EHS monitoring (e.g., emissions tracking software).

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes and associated risks.
* Expertise in EHS \& ESG regulations and EPR frameworks.
* Proficiency in sustainability practices , GHG accounting, Product carbon footprint, life cycle assessment (LCA) \& knowledge on ISO14064\.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills for hazard identification and mitigation.
* Strong communication skills for training delivery and stakeholder engagement.

**Experience**

* 8\-10 years experience of leading EHS and Sustainability topics in manufacturing/automobile sector.

 **Additional Information**  

This role is pivotal in aligning manufacturing operations with modern sustainability goals while ensuring a safe working environment for all stakeholders.

· Familiarity with industrial automation components: sensors, actuators, VFDs, and other networking hardware.

· Strong knowledge of communication protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, Serial, and Ethernet.

· Ability to interpret and work with AutoCAD or e\-Plan electrical schematics (added advantage).

· Self\-driven with the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.

B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics \& Telecommunication, or Instrumentation Engineering.

· Sharp acumen for logic building and automation problem\-solving.

title: Founders Office Trainee- Management and Operations
description:
About the job

**Location:** Bangalore

**Department:** Founder’s Office / Management \& Operations

**Role Type:** Internship / Trainee Program

**Experience Level:** Entry Level

About ARCHLE Labs

ARCHLE Labs – Advanced Research Centre for Health and Life Science Engineering is a health\-tech R\&D startup based in Bangalore. We are building science and engineering\-driven healthcare solutions that improve access, affordability, and quality of care.

Our vision is simple:

**To make quality healthcare accessible to everyone.**

India needs healthcare solutions that are practical, scalable, and accessible across diverse communities. This requires professionals who can support systems, coordinate teams, manage operations, and help bring innovation to the people who need it most.

At ARCHLE Labs, your work will not be limited to routine office tasks. You will be part of a mission\-driven team working to build products, systems, and operations that support the future of public health.

About the Program

The Management Leadership Trainee Program at the Founder’s Office is designed for entry\-level candidates who want to build strong foundations in operations, management, execution, coordination, and business leadership.

This is a hands\-on training program where trainees receive exposure across multiple management functions, including HR, finance, accounting, operations, administration, marketing, sales, business development, legal, compliance, product coordination, and executive support.

During the first 6 months, trainees will receive structured on\-the\-job training, mentorship, and career guidance. After 6 months, based on interest, performance, and business requirements, trainees may choose one discipline to specialize in or continue working in overall operations and management.

ARCHLE Labs is committed to building inclusive leadership in healthcare, public health, operations, and management. We welcome applicants from different educational, professional, regional, and social backgrounds who are interested in healthcare access, public health, and meaningful work.

Work Culture

This program is designed for candidates who want to learn through responsibility, ownership, and practical execution.

This is a hands\-on learning and leadership development opportunity for candidates who are willing to take initiative, ask questions, communicate clearly, and contribute from the beginning.

ARCHLE Labs operates in a dynamic startup environment. The role may involve changing priorities, important deadlines, cross\-functional coordination, and occasional time\-sensitive work based on project needs.

We are looking for candidates who can manage tasks responsibly, communicate updates clearly, follow through on commitments, and take ownership of assigned work.

What You Will Learn

**Founder’s Office \& Strategy:** Work closely with the founders and senior leadership team on planning, execution, tracking, research, and strategic initiatives.

**Operations Management:** Understand how daily business operations are planned, monitored, improved, and scaled in a health\-tech startup.

**HR \& People Operations:** Support talent acquisition, onboarding, employee engagement, documentation, coordination, and people management processes.

**Finance \& Accounting:** Learn the basics of budgeting, expense tracking, financial reporting, vendor coordination, and business planning.

**Administration \& Coordination:** Support internal meetings, scheduling, office coordination, vendor management, documentation, and executive assistance.

**Marketing \& Branding:** Assist in brand communication, content creation, digital campaigns, presentations, and outreach material.

**Sales \& Business Development:** Support lead generation, client research, customer outreach, proposal preparation, and sales strategy execution.

**Legal \& Compliance:** Gain exposure to contracts, regulatory documentation, compliance workflows, and process documentation.

**Product \& Innovation Coordination:** Collaborate with R\&D and product teams to understand healthcare product development, user needs, market feedback, and implementation requirements.

**Leadership \& Team Management:** Build leadership skills by taking ownership of small projects, coordinating with teams, managing deliverables, and solving practical problems.

Roles \& Responsibilities

As a Management Leadership Trainee, you will:

* Support strategic initiatives from the Founder’s Office.
* Assist in planning, execution, and tracking of business priorities.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, public health research, and internal assessments.
* Prepare presentations, reports, dashboards, and briefing documents.
* Coordinate with teams across operations, R\&D, sales, marketing, HR, finance, and administration.
* Support day\-to\-day operations and help improve internal processes.
* Assist in project management, follow\-ups, timelines, and deliverables.
* Identify gaps in execution and suggest practical solutions.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and ensure timely completion.
* Contribute to initiatives that support ARCHLE Labs’ mission in healthcare access and public health.

Who Should Apply

This program may be a good fit for candidates who are:

* Interested in building a career in management, operations, business strategy, healthcare management, or startup leadership.
* Interested in public health, healthcare access, social impact, and innovation.
* Willing to learn through real projects and practical responsibilities.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic startup environment.
* Good at communication, coordination, research, and documentation.
* Organized, reliable, and able to follow through on assigned tasks.
* Interested in understanding how a health\-tech startup is built from the inside.
* Motivated by meaningful work and long\-term professional growth.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Management, Commerce, Economics, Healthcare Management, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field. Candidates from other disciplines with relevant skills or experience are also encouraged to apply.
* 0–2 years of experience. Students completing their degree may also apply if they can commit to the role requirements.
* Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Proficiency in Hindi or regional languages such as Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, or Malayalam is helpful for field coordination, partner communication, and public health outreach, but is not mandatory.
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving ability.
* Interest in public health, health\-tech, social impact, operations, or entrepreneurship.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through responsibly.
* Prior internship, project, volunteering, NCC, NSS, leadership, sports, or event coordination experience is welcome but not required.

Program Structure

**First 6 Months – Rotational Training:**

Trainees will receive hands\-on training across different management departments and work on real business tasks.

**Mentorship \& Career Guidance:**

Trainees will receive guidance from founders, senior team members, and department leads to understand their strengths, interests, and career direction.

**Post 6 Months – Choose Your Path:**

After 6 months, trainees may specialize in one area such as HR, finance, operations, marketing, sales, legal, product coordination, or continue in overall operations, based on interest, performance, and company requirements.

Why Join ARCHLE Labs?

* Work on a mission that supports healthcare access and public health.
* Build a management foundation across multiple departments.
* Learn through real projects, practical tasks, and live business challenges.
* Work closely with founders and senior team members.
* Build confidence, ownership, communication, decision\-making, and execution skills.
* Contribute to healthcare innovation that can serve communities at scale.

Equal Opportunity Statement

ARCHLE Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including different genders, regions, communities, socioeconomic backgrounds, educational pathways, and career journeys.

Candidates do not need prior startup experience to apply. We value curiosity, reliability, communication, willingness to learn, and commitment to meaningful work.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their resume, a short cover letter, and any relevant project, internship, volunteering, leadership, sports, or coordination experience details to:

* **hr@archlelabs.com**

title: HR Recruitment Executive
description:
**Job Description: Recruitment Executive at IND**

**Position Title:** Recruitment Executive  
**Location:** Sovabazar, Kolkata  
**Work Type:** Full\-time

**About the Role:**

As a Recruitment Executive at IND, based in Sovabazar, Kolkata, you will play a key role in sourcing, attracting, and hiring the best talent to meet the dynamic needs of the organization. Reporting directly to the Managing Director’s Office (MDO), your role will involve handling end\-to\-end recruitment, establishing strong external networks, and proactively engaging in diverse activities to ensure the success of recruitment initiatives. This position requires a hands\-on approach, including physically visiting and building relationships with various organizations, educational institutions, and networks for sourcing talent.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Talent Acquisition:**

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, selecting, and onboarding candidates.
* Explore and utilize diverse sourcing channels, including job portals, social media, referrals, campus recruitment, and in\-person networking, to attract top talent.
* Build and maintain relationships with colleges, universities, training institutes, and other organizations to create a robust talent pipeline.
* Visit external organizations, attend career fairs, and conduct outreach programs to expand the pool of prospective candidates.

**Candidate Evaluation and Engagement:**

* Conduct initial candidate screenings to assess qualifications, experience, and cultural fit.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and department heads, ensuring seamless candidate communication.
* Maintain a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Support new hires during onboarding to ensure a smooth transition into the organization.

**Process Management and Strategy:**

* Work closely with the Managing Director’s Office to align recruitment efforts with organizational goals and priorities.
* Define and execute tri\-monthly, monthly, weekly, and daily recruitment objectives in collaboration with the MDO.
* Keep detailed records of recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-hire, quality of hires, and cost efficiency.
* Continuously improve recruitment processes to ensure efficiency and effectiveness.

**Networking and Outreach:**

* Actively engage with external organizations, colleges, and talent hubs to promote IND as an employer of choice.
* Establish partnerships with relevant organizations for sourcing candidates, including niche hiring needs.
* Represent IND at networking events, seminars, and job fairs to enhance the organization’s employer brand.

**Support for MDO and Diverse Activities:**

* Act as a point of coordination for recruitment\-related activities for the Managing Director’s Office.
* Be open to diverse and dynamic tasks beyond recruitment, as assigned by the MDO, to support organizational goals.
* Engage in activities that align with the strategic objectives of the organization, demonstrating flexibility and initiative.

**Key Skills and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition, with a preference for candidates with experience in external networking and outreach.
* Excellent communication skills in Bengali, Hindi, and English (verbal and written).
* Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills to build relationships with external organizations and candidates.
* Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable with traveling locally and physically visiting organizations, colleges, and other institutions as part of recruitment efforts.
* Knowledge of recruitment tools and strategies, including job portals and social media platforms.

**Preferred Attributes:**

* Background in recruitment for educational, healthcare, or neurodevelopment\-focused organizations.
* Prior experience in campus hiring, networking, or relationship\-building with institutions.
* A growth\-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn and take on new challenges.
* Flexibility to engage in tasks beyond recruitment, as required by the Managing Director’s Office.

**Key Metrics for Success:**

* Quality of hires and their alignment with organizational goals.
* Time\-to\-hire for open positions and efficiency of the recruitment process.
* Effectiveness in building and maintaining external networks for sourcing.
* Success in achieving recruitment targets set by the Managing Director’s Office.
* Positive feedback from candidates and hiring managers regarding the recruitment process.

**Why Join IND?**

At IND, we are committed to creating meaningful change in the lives of children with Autism and other neurodevelopmental challenges. As a Recruitment Executive, you will play a critical role in building a team that supports our mission. This is an opportunity to engage in impactful work, grow professionally, and contribute to a transformative organization.

title: Nursing Superintendent
description:
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** 

Ø Work lawfully, co\-operatively and amicably with all the medical and other nursing staffs.

Ø Responsible for day to day patient care to the allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for Bed Making, Mouth Care, Sponging, Personal Hygiene, Back care/ Skin care of Allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for drug administration (Follow 6R Policy), Checking bed side stock medicines, Feeding (Oral/Ryle’s tube/ Parental).

Ø Proper Maintenance of case sheet.

Ø Responsible for assisting in Doctor’s round, Procedures, Investigation/OT preparation of allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for assisting \& helping with all the necessary information of the patient during doctor’s round of the allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for hand over and takeover of inventories and medicines of the allocated patient and ward.

Ø Responsible for helping in elimination of waste and to maintain Hospital Infection Control.

Ø Responsible for providing psychological support to the allocated patient and their relatives. All nursing staff will be wearing black shoe with proper uniform on duty.

Ø You have to join duty before 10 minutes of scheduled time. Handover should be taken post checking inventory, stock medicine, and consumables.

Ø Handover should be carried out in beside with medicine card and hand over register.

Ø Using personal mobile on duty hours is not allowed.

Ø Morning staff on duty will go for lunch only after handing over and evening duty staff will take hand over post lunch. Lunch after hand over is not allowed.

Ø Evening duty staff have to attend weekly classes of Dr. Talapatra, Mr.Koushik Hazra, Microbiologist and any Consultant’s classes. Any non\-adherence will be treated as absence from duty.

Ø GDA will take part in sponging, bed making, urine pot and giving bed pan,.

Ø 2 hourly back care have to given for ICCU patient.

Ø Don’t take leave without information of Technician.

Ø If any uncertain problem arises in Department then immediate inform to related technical person.

Ø Register of handover, stock medicine, inventory, pathology, radiology, blood transfusion must have to maintain.

Ø All staff must have to respect to senior, don’t make noise with senior.

Ø Non\-functional machines information must be pass on to Technician.

Ø In case of OT’s PAC ( Pre anesthetic checkup ) must be ensured in coordination with Floor Manager.

Ø Ensure all vital statistics checkup properly before writing in the note sheet for example urine out, Blood Pressure etc.

Ø In case of discharge extra medicine should be returned to pharmacy.

Ø Discharge medicine dosages must be discussed with patient party while patient gets discharged.

Ø For outside Diagnostics / Pathology tests floor manager must be informed and proper register to be maintained. Patient file should not accompany with the patient.

Ø To maintain TAT (Turn Around Time) in line with NABH proper register should be maintained in all wards.

Ø In case of emergency RMO must be connected through ward Cell phone and recording must be presented while enquiry.

Ø Dietary restrictions must be maintained in consultation with Dietician.

Ø Blood requisition should be rooted through Doctor. Proper protocol for Blood Transfusion must be followed at every step.

Ø During discharge Inter Venous channel and other external fixation must be removed from patient’s body.

Ø Medicines brand name and expiry date must be precisely checked before giving to the patients.

Ø Responsible for maintaining co\-ordination between patient/family and the Doctor.

Ø Responsible for performing in bedside physiotherapy/Breathing Exercise, Heamo Dynamic Monitoring \& Recording, Assisting major and minor dressings, Inhalation and nebulization, IV cannulation injection, IV therapy \& blood transfusion, ECG.

Ø Responsible for performing in CBS Checking/Suction, Charting/Recording and assessment chart filing, position changing and bedside care of the patient.

Ø Maintain stock of Emergency medicines with other inventories and sterile equipment checking for expiry date.

Ø Responsible for handling and maintaining crash cart trolley with the help of Sister Incharge.

Ø Check the crash cart trolley on the daily basis and also at the time of shift changing.

Ø Supervise Laundry stock.

Ø Cleaning and antiseptic Dressing, Maintaining aseptic technique and hand washing of allocated patient.

Ø Maintaining Admission, Transfer, Discharge, DOR, DORB procedure and patient file.

Ø Maintaining the entire check list \& nursing assessment documentation.

Ø Supervising good hygiene of ward and patient’s toilet.

Ø Proper maintaining of humidifier in central oxygen line.

Ø Instrument handling and maintaining (Monitors, Pulse Oxymeter, Syringe Pump, Infusion Pump, ECG machine, Defibrillator, Cardiac Monitor, Ventilator, Pulse generator, Holter monitor, CVP line etc.).

Ø Proper communication of all the sentinel events to the nursing administration.

Ø Participating in service classes regularly arranged by HR Department.

Ø Report to Sister In charge of the unit in related to any nursing care problem during work and must carry out her order to the best of your ability.

Ø Involvement in direct patient care along with admission, discharge, transfer in \& out and death protocols.

Ø Bridging gap between patient's party \& doctors.

Ø Assisting the MS/Visiting Consultant/Nursing Super/RMO/MO in their rounds.

Ø Supervision of all staff in completing clinical assessment chart of every patient including MOM.

Ø Report any unwanted incident to Sister In Charge/ Nursing Super

Ø Maintaining discipline and awareness of hospital policies \& protocols.

Ø Maintaining crash cart protocol.

Ø Maintaining disposal of biomedical waste.

Ø Responsible for helping QC team in collecting data and feedbacks.

Ø Responsible for cleanliness and ventilation of wards, service rooms and sanitary area as well as to the cleanliness of cupboards, floor, utensils etc.

Ø Responsible for all activity sheets and updating sheet for proper billing.

Ø Responsible for diet prescribing/changing /discharge/investigation/reports awaited/pre \& post operative procedures/PAC done/pending.

Ø Maintenance of Ward equipments \& biomedical equipments \& linen.

Ø Communicate with the Sister In Charge / Nursing Super in case of any infringement of misconduct committed by patient or their relatives.

Ø Responsible for maintaining Hospital Infection Control in collaboration with Sister in Charge/ Nursing Super and Infection Control committee.

Ø Exercise particular care in the event of discharge, transfer or death of patient.

Ø Responsible for special care for vulnerable patients.

Ø Responsible for end of life care procedure.

Ø Responsible for maintaining colour codes of patient.

Ø To perform all other duties as and when required for the better service of the hospital assigned by competent authority.

Ø The aforesaid work profile is illustrative in nature not exhaustive.

Reports / Records:

Records to be maintained are:

· Admission, transfer and discharge

· Stock Register of Medicine, Syringe.

· Stock Register of Linen of patient etc.

· Crash cart check list

· Register quality indicators.

· Event Register.

· Notifiable disease register.

· Handover register.

· Patient complaint book.

· Master equipment list.

· Equipment movement register.

· Equipment complaint book.

title: System Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical **Systems Engineer Intern / Fresher** to join our engineering infrastructure team. In this role, you will assist in building, maintaining, and troubleshooting our growing IT environments and systems. You will work closely with software developers and operations teams to ensure the highest levels of system availability, performance, and security. This is an ideal launchpad for an aspiring engineer eager to gain deep, hands\-on experience with server administration, networking, and automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **System Monitoring:** Assist in monitoring and supporting installed systems, servers, and infrastructure to ensure maximum availability and performance.
* **Installation \& Configuration:** Help install, configure, test, and maintain operating systems (primarily Linux/Unix and Windows), application software, and system management tools.
* **Troubleshooting:** Proactively diagnose, report, and resolve basic hardware, software, and network connectivity issues.
* **Task Automation:** Learn and write basic scripts (e.g., Python, Bash, or PowerShell) to automate routine operational tasks and reduce human intervention time.
* **Team Collaboration:** Work alongside developers and core engineering teams to identify system bottlenecks and support routine deployment cycles.
* **Technical Documentation:** Maintain clear, structured, and updated documentation for system configurations, deployment guides, and operational procedures.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* **Core Concepts:** Solid foundational understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, OSI model, VPNs).
* **OS Knowledge:** Practical familiarity with Linux/Unix command lines or Windows Server administration.
* **Scripting (Preferred):** Basic knowledge of a scripting language like Python or Bash is a strong advantage.
* **Mindset:** Strong analytical and problem solving mindset, sharp attention to detail, and a deep willingness to learn new technologies quickly.
* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

**What We Offer**

* Direct mentorship from senior engineering leaders in an agile startup ecosystem.
* Hands\-on exposure to live production systems, cloud environments, and modern infrastructure practices.
* A vibrant, flat\-hierarchy workplace culture where initiative is highly rewarded.
* A clear pathway to full\-time career conversion based on performance during the internship.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

**Job Title: Sales Manager**

**Role Overview:**  
The Sales Manager oversees all sales activities within the organization and is responsible for developing and implementing sales strategies to drive growth and meet or exceed sales targets. * **Sales Performance Analysis:** Analyze sales data, market trends, and competitor activities to identify areas for improvement and develop actionable insights to optimize sales performance.
* **Forecasting and Budgeting:** Prepare sales forecasts and budgets based on market analysis and business objectives. Monitor performance against targets and take corrective actions as needed.

* **Reporting:** Generate regular sales reports and present findings to senior management, providing updates on sales performance, market trends, and opportunities for growth.

* Proven track record of success in sales, with experience in sales management preferred.
* Strong leadership and motivational skills, with the ability to inspire and coach a diverse team.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and negotiate effectively.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret sales data and market trends to drive informed decisions.
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and exceeding targets.
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, marketing, or a related field (MBA is a plus).
* Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.

**Working Conditions:**

* The Sales Manager typically works in an office environment but may also spend time meeting with clients and attending industry events.
* This role may require occasional travel to meet with clients or attend conferences.

**Salary Range:**  
The salary for a Sales Manager varies depending on factors such as experience, industry, location, and company size. On average, the salary range for a Sales Manager is $60,000 to $150,000 per year, with additional bonuses and commissions based on performance.

**Conclusion:**  
A Sales Manager plays a critical role in driving revenue growth and maximizing profitability for an organization. By leading a high\-performing sales team and implementing effective sales strategies, the Sales Manager contributes to the overall success and competitiveness of the business.

title: Recruitment & Training Coordinator
description:
Role Summary

The Recruitment \& Training Coordinator will be responsible for supporting manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, employee training, and skill development across Unimech’s foundry, machine shop, quality, maintenance, stores, and office functions. The role will ensure that the right people are hired, properly inducted, trained for their responsibilities, and continuously developed to meet Unimech’s operational and growth requirements.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities

1\. Recruitment Coordination

* Coordinate with department heads to understand manpower requirements.
* Prepare and publish job postings on platforms such as Indeed, LinkedIn, WhatsApp groups, local agencies, and recruitment portals.
* Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule interviews with department heads and management.
* Maintain a recruitment tracker with candidate status, feedback, joining dates, and salary expectations.
* Coordinate with contractors and agencies for labour requirements, especially for foundry operations.
* Support hiring for operators, helpers, technicians, inspectors, office staff, and junior management roles.

2\. Interview \& Selection Support

* Conduct initial screening calls with candidates.
* Verify basic experience, salary expectations, notice period, location preference, and willingness to work in a manufacturing environment.
* Arrange trade tests or practical evaluations where required.
* Collect interview feedback from technical teams.
* Support offer discussions and joining coordination.

3\. Onboarding \& Joining Formalities

* Ensure new employees complete joining documents, ID proof, bank details, photographs, and statutory forms.
* Coordinate induction for new joiners.
* Explain company rules, attendance requirements, leave procedure, safety expectations, and reporting structure.
* Ensure new employees are introduced to their department head and team.
* Maintain employee records in physical and digital formats.

4\. Training Coordination

* Identify training needs in discussion with department heads.
* Prepare and maintain a training calendar for workers, staff, supervisors, and new joiners.
* Coordinate internal training sessions on safety, quality, process discipline, ERP usage, inspection practices, and workplace behaviour.
* Track training attendance and effectiveness.
* Maintain training records for audits and customer requirements.
* Follow up with employees and supervisors to ensure training learnings are implemented on the shop floor.

5\. Skill Matrix \& Competency Development

* Maintain department\-wise skill matrices for foundry, machining, NDT, inspection, stores, maintenance, and office teams.
* Track employee skill levels and identify gaps.
* Coordinate cross\-training and upskilling plans.
* Support development of multi\-skilled employees to improve flexibility in production.
* Monitor progress of trainees, helpers, and junior staff.

6\. Compliance \& Documentation

* Maintain recruitment files, interview records, appointment letters, training records, and employee documents.
* Support HR documentation required for audits, customer visits, and statutory compliance.
* Ensure training records are properly filed and retrievable.
* Assist in maintaining records related to safety training, quality training, and process training.

7\. Employee Communication \& Follow\-Up

* Act as a coordinator between HR, management, department heads, employees, and labour contractors.
* Follow up with new employees during the initial joining period.
* Escalate attendance, behaviour, or performance concerns to HR/management.
* Support communication of company policies, discipline requirements, and training initiatives.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Good communication skills in English, Malayalam and Tamil; Hindi will be an added advantage.
* Ability to speak confidently with candidates, workers, supervisors, and managers.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing recruitment.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Good record\-keeping and documentation ability.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, email, and job portals.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Practical, disciplined, and shop\-floor oriented approach.

Preferred Experience

* 1–4 years of experience in HR, recruitment, training coordination, or manpower coordination.
* Experience in a manufacturing, foundry, machining, engineering, or industrial environment preferred.
* Fresh HR graduates may also be considered if they are strong in communication and follow\-up.

Key Performance Indicators

* Time taken to close open positions.
* Quality and retention of new hires.
* Completion of joining formalities on time.
* Training calendar adherence.
* Training attendance and documentation accuracy.
* Skill matrix updates and closure of identified skill gaps.
* Support provided to departments for manpower availability.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

description:
Good with people and thinking creatively?  
 




**If yes, then you need to read this.** 




  





**Integra Magna is hiring an HR \& Marketing Intern.** 




  






 You’ll help us find and hire great people, create smoother employee experiences, and support marketing campaigns that make our brand stand out online and offline.
 




  






 If you enjoy working with people, love creative ideas, and want a role that blends HR with marketing, keep reading.

* Support recruitment by sourcing candidates, screening resumes, coordinating interviews, and maintaining hiring records.
* Plan creative employee engagement activities and team initiatives that help build a positive workplace culture and bridge the gap between remote and on\-site teams.
* Research trends, generate content and campaign ideas, write blogs/captions, and support Integra Magna’s organic brand visibility across digital platforms.
* Coordinate with the design team to organize content, manage social media updates, and support Integra Magna’s digital presence across platforms.

 We’re looking for someone adaptable and open to supporting related team requirements and responsibilities as needed.

* You have strong written and verbal communication skills and enjoy interacting with people
* You’re comfortable using LinkedIn, spreadsheets, and social platforms.



  





**Life at Integra Magna?** 





 Music playing in the background, coffee brewing in the studio, and people casually turning random thoughts into real ideas.
 





 You won’t be stuck doing “intern work” here. You’ll work on actual projects, sit in on real conversations, share ideas freely, and learn through real\-time client work.
 




  






 Some days are super focused. Some turn into creative chaos. Some somehow become playlist debates instead of meetings.
 





 We care way more about curiosity, taste, ambition, and good energy than perfect resumes.

description:
**Position:** MSW Officer

**Location**: Baramati, Tal \- Baramati, Dist \- Pune

**Department:** Labour Welfare / Human Resources

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Job Summary:**

The Welfare Officer is responsible for ensuring the well\-being and welfare of sugarcane harvesting labourers employed by the sugar factory. This role includes overseeing living and working conditions, addressing grievances, facilitating access to essential services. The Welfare Officer acts as a bridge between the workers and management to promote a healthy, safe, and productive work environment.

**Key Responsibilities:** 

**1\. Human Rights Due Diligence (HRDD):** 

\- Conduct HRDD assessments in coordination with mill management, identifying and mitigating risks to workers’ rights.

\- Develop and implement strategies to address workplace human rights issues, with particular focus on women’s welfare and gender equity.

\- Provide training on human rights principles, including prevention of harassment, gender sensitivity, and anti\-discrimination practices.

\- Collaborate with the sustainability manager of client companies to meet HRDD standards and ensure transparent communication.

\- Grievance Mechanisms: Support the development and monitoring of safe, anonymous grievance redressal mechanisms.

**2\. Occupational Health and Safety (OHS):** 

**\-** Develop, implement, and enforce OHS policies and practices at the workplace.

\- Conduct safety audits, risk assessments, and site inspections to identify and resolve hazards.

\- Organize training programs to promote a culture of safety, focusing on vulnerable groups, including women and seasonal workers.

\- Investigate and document workplace accidents, ensuring that corrective and preventive actions are in place.

**3\. Fair Working Conditions and Women’s Welfare:** 

**\-** Ensure compliance with fair wages, reasonable working hours, and equitable treatment of all workers.

\- Advocate for and address women’s issues, including workplace safety, health, hygiene, and childcare support.

\- Work with HR teams to establish policies for maternity benefits, equal opportunities, and grievance redressal mechanisms for women workers.

\- Mediate conflicts and resolve grievances, fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

**4\. Field Visits and Worker Engagement:** 

\- Conduct regular field visits to harvesting workers' camps to evaluate living conditions, access to health facilities, and compliance with labor laws.

\- Engage with workers to identify their concerns, ensuring their voices are incorporated into management decisions.

\- Document findings from field visits and prepare actionable recommendations for improvements.

**5\. Grievance Mechanisms:**

\- Support the development and implementation of safe, anonymous grievance redressal mechanisms for workers.

\- Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of grievance systems, ensuring accessibility and fairness for all workers.

\- Address grievances promptly and transparently, maintaining a record of complaints and resolutions.

\- Conduct periodic reviews to improve grievance mechanisms based on feedback and best practices.

**6\. Stakeholder Coordination:** 

**\-** Act as the primary liaison between mill management, client representatives, and internal HRDD and sustainability teams.

\- Collaborate with external stakeholders, including NGOs, auditors, and government bodies, to promote compliance with human rights and safety standards.

\- Regularly update the sustainability manager of the company’s clients on progress, challenges, and mitigation strategies.

**7\. Reporting and Documentation:**

\- Prepare detailed reports on HRDD, OHS, and gender\-related initiatives for internal and external stakeholders. Maintain accurate records of inspections, incidents, and resolutions to support compliance and continuous improvement efforts.  Track and analyze KPIs related to HRDD, OHS, and women’s welfare programs.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

\- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Social Work / Rural Development / Labour Welfare or related field.

\- Minimum 2–6 years of experience in labour welfare, preferably in agriculture or factory settings.

\- Knowledge of local language and familiarity with rural labour issues.

\- Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem\-solving skills.

**Desirable Attributes:**

\- Empathetic and people\-centric approach.

\- Willingness to travel to field areas or cane harvesting sites if and when required.

description:
**Job Summary:**

The **HR Manager – Labour** is responsible for managing and maintaining healthy employee–employer relations, ensuring compliance with all labour laws, handling union matters, maintaining statutory records, and ensuring a productive and disciplined workforce. The role requires a blend of strong communication, legal understanding, and interpersonal skills to maintain a harmonious industrial environment.

**Key Responsibilities:1\. Labour Relations \& Employee Welfare**

* Maintain peaceful industrial relations by managing communication between management and workers/unions.
* Resolve grievances of workmen promptly to prevent disputes and maintain workforce harmony.
* Conduct regular meetings with union representatives and employee welfare committees.
* Implement welfare measures such as canteen, transport, housing, safety, and health facilities.

**2\. Compliance \& Statutory Management**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws — *Factories Act, Industrial Disputes Act, Payment of Wages Act, Minimum Wages Act, Employees’ Provident Fund Act, ESI Act, etc.*
* Maintain statutory registers, records, and returns as per government norms.
* Coordinate with government departments during inspections, audits, and labour office visits.
* Prepare and submit periodic compliance reports to management.

**3\. Workforce Management**

* Oversee attendance, leave management, overtime, and shift scheduling for workers.
* Manage contract labour through coordination with contractors and ensure adherence to *Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act*.
* Conduct manpower planning and ensure adequate workforce availability for production.
* Handle disciplinary actions, domestic inquiries, and misconduct cases following standing orders.

**4\. Training \& Development**

* Identify training needs of workers and conduct skill upgradation programs.
* Arrange awareness sessions on safety, hygiene, and labour rights.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement.

**5\. Communication \& Reporting**

* Act as a liaison between factory management and HR head office.
* Prepare MIS reports on labour strength, absenteeism, turnover, and grievances.
* Support in collective bargaining and wage negotiations.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience:**

* **Education:** MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management, Labour Welfare, or Industrial Relations.
* **Experience:** 5–10 years of experience in HR \& IR functions, preferably in a manufacturing or plant environment.
* **Knowledge:** Thorough understanding of Indian labour laws, industrial relations practices, and statutory compliance.
* **Skills:** Negotiation, conflict resolution, leadership, communication, documentation, and government liaison.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong interpersonal and problem\-solving skills.
* High integrity and confidentiality in handling employee issues.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage crisis situations.
* Sound judgment and decision\-making capabilities.

**For Swing, Long\-Term, Multibagger \& Safe Investment Research**

**Job Title**

**Equity Research Analyst – Swing, Long\-Term \& Multibagger Research**

**Role Type**

Full\-time

**Location**

Chennai (In office only)

**Reporting To**

Chief Trader / Principal Trader

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a research\-driven **Equity Research Analyst** to support a private trading and investment desk with fundamental research, sector analysis, swing ideas, long\-term investment opportunities, safe stock identification, and multibagger research.

The candidate should be able to analyse listed companies, read financial statements, study annual reports, track quarterly results, understand sector cycles, and prepare concise stock notes for decision\-making.

This role is not for giving random market tips. The candidate must provide structured research with clear reasoning, valuation comfort, risks, and thesis tracking.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Fundamental Stock Research**

Prepare research notes covering:

* Company overview
* Business model
* Revenue segments
* Promoter background
* Management quality
* Financial performance
* Debt levels
* Cash flows
* Profit margins
* Return ratios
* Valuation
* Growth triggers
* Risks
* Peer comparison
* Investment thesis
* Exit conditions

**2\. Long\-Term Investment Research**

Identify and track:

* Quality compounders
* Safe long\-term stocks
* Sector leaders
* Low\-debt companies
* Cash\-flow strong companies
* High ROE/ROCE businesses
* Consistent profit growers
* Companies with strong moats
* Businesses with long runway

**3\. Multibagger Research**

Study high\-growth opportunities in:

* Smallcap companies
* Midcap companies
* Emerging sectors
* Turnaround stories
* Capacity expansion stories
* Export\-led businesses
* Import substitution themes
* Niche manufacturing companies
* Commodity cycle beneficiaries
* Capex\-driven sectors

**4\. Swing and Positional Research**

Support short\-term and medium\-term opportunities based on:

* Results momentum
* Sectoral tailwinds
* Earnings upgrades
* Management commentary
* Breakout with fundamentals
* Valuation re\-rating
* News/event triggers
* Commodity\-linked sector movements

**5\. Sector Research**

Maintain sector notes on:

* Metals
* Mining
* Oil \& gas
* Cement
* Power
* Renewable energy
* Capital goods
* Defence
* Railways
* Chemicals
* Infrastructure
* Banking/NBFC

* IT

* Revenue growth

* PAT growth
* Margin movement
* Debt movement
* Management commentary
* Guidance
* Order book, if applicable
* Capex update
* Valuation impact
* Upgrade/downgrade view

**7\. Watchlist Management**

Maintain separate watchlists:

1\. Safe Long\-Term Stocks  
2\. Swing Trading Candidates  
3\. Multibagger Watchlist  
4\. Commodity\-Linked Stocks  
5\. Metal Sector Watchlist  
6\. High\-Risk High\-Reward Stocks  
7\. Result Season Opportunities  
8\. Avoid List  
9\. Overvalued Quality Stocks  
10\. Turnaround Candidates

title: Intern - Procurement & Resource Development
description:
**Intern: Procurement \& Resource Development**

**Place of Posting: Purnea, BIhar**

**About Company:**

AgroKisan, a brand owned by Krishi Samriddhi Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an innovative Agritech startups, leveraging cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize agriculture in India. AgroKisan focus on precision farming, agriculture value chain, and sustainable solutions for efficiency and resilience in agricultural sector. With a commitment to modernizing practices, AgroKisan play a vital role in shaping a more sustainable and productive future for Indian Agriculture Ecosystem. We are supported by Govt. of Bihar and incubated under Indian Institute of Technology, Patna.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Intern to join our Agribusiness team. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in various aspects of agricultural industry. This role offers exposure to a fast\-paced and innovative environment where you will work closely with our sales and marketing professionals to support our business objectives.

**Role Overview**

The Intern – Procurement (Agri Commodity) \& Resource Development will be responsible for sourcing agricultural commodities, managing field\-level procurement operations, and developing a strong network of farmers, FPOs, vendors, and field resources. The role ensures high\-quality, cost\-effective procurement while building sustainable relationships across the agriculture value chain. It also involves developing and training field partners, enabling efficient supply aggregation, and strengthening resource planning for ongoing agritech operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Agri Commodity Procurement**

* Identify and onboard farmers, FPOs/FPCs, aggregators, and traders for commodity sourcing.
* Conduct market research to track commodity prices, demand patterns, and seasonal availability.
* Negotiate procurement terms, quality parameters, and logistics with suppliers.
* Ensure timely procurement of commodities such as fruits, vegetables, grains, spices, pulses, or any crop aligned with company operations.
* Coordinate quality checks during procurement and ensure adherence to grading and standard specifications.
* Support contract farming or buy\-back arrangements with growers where applicable.

**2\. Field Resource Development \& Network Expansion**

* Develop a robust field network including farmers, FPOs, community leaders, agri\-input dealers, and rural micro\-entrepreneurs.
* Train and support field partners on procurement processes, quality parameters, and digital reporting tools.
* Conduct field visits to assess crop readiness, farmer engagement, and resource availability.
* Build a database of field resources to support sourcing, aggregation, and logistics operations.
* Identify new sourcing clusters and build market linkages in potential agri\-growing regions.

**3\. Supply Chain \& Operational Support**

* Coordinate logistics, transportation, and last\-mile pickup from sourcing locations to warehouses or processing centers.
* Work closely with operations and quality teams to ensure a seamless procurement\-to\-delivery pipeline.
* Assist in planning procurement volumes based on demand forecasts and operational needs.
* Ensure minimal wastage, efficient handling, and cost\-effective aggregation.

**4\. Stakeholder \& Vendor Relationship Management**

* Maintain strong relationships with suppliers, farmers, FPO leaders, and local market stakeholders.
* Conduct periodic supplier evaluations based on quality, reliability, and pricing.
* Resolve field\-level issues related to quality disputes, procurement delays, or logistics challenges.
* Collaborate with government agencies, NGOs, or agri institutions for field\-level resource development.

**5\. Resource Planning, Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain updated records of procurement volumes, sourcing locations, farmer databases, vendor details, and field activities.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly reports on procurement performance, price trends, and field resource development.
* Ensure documentation compliance including purchase orders, agreements, receipts, and quality reports.
* Use digital tools or ERP systems to log procurement and field data accurately.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s/Master degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Rural Development, Supply Chain, or related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Agribusiness or Rural Management preferred.

**Work Experience**

* Freshers can also apply
* Prior experience in agri commodity procurement, field sourcing, supply chain, or rural operations will be prefered.
* Experience working with farmers, FPOs, mandi operations, rural networks, or agritech companies is highly desirable.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong understanding of agri commodities, market dynamics, crop cycles, and quality standards.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and vendor management skills.
* Ability to build rapport with farmers and rural stakeholders.
* Knowledge of mandi operations, auction systems, and procurement compliance.
* Good analytical and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, procurement tools, and mobile\-based field reporting apps.
* Willingness to travel extensively to sourcing clusters.

**Key Personal Attributes**

* Field\-focused attitude with problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong interpersonal skills with empathy toward farmers and rural communities.
* Proactive, reliable, and able to work independently.
* Ability to handle pressure and dynamic procurement requirements.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work at the intersection of agriculture, technology, and supply chain innovation.
* Hands\-on exposure to emerging agritech business models.
* Career growth in procurement, rural operations, and supplier development.
* Direct impact on farmer livelihoods and sustainable sourcing.

Interested Candidate may send thier cv at hr@agrokisan.com

**Company:** Earthen Textures™  
**Department:** Sales / Lead Management

Role Summary

We are looking for a confident and well\-spoken **Tele Caller** who will be responsible for calling all leads generated through digital marketing campaigns such as Facebook, Instagram, Google, WhatsApp, website inquiries, and other online platforms.

The main responsibility of this role is to quickly connect with interested customers, understand their requirements, share basic product information, qualify the lead, and pass serious inquiries to the sales team for follow\-up and closure.

Key Responsibilities

* **Lead Calling**
* Call all leads received from digital marketing campaigns.
* Make the first call as quickly as possible after the lead is received.
* Follow up with leads who do not answer or ask to be called later.
* **Lead Qualification**
* Understand the customer’s requirement, project type, location, and budget.
* Identify whether the lead is an architect, interior designer, builder, contractor, dealer, or direct customer.
* Mark leads as hot, warm, cold, or not relevant.
* **Product Explanation**
* Explain basic details of Earthen Textures products.
* Share product catalogues, images, videos, brochures, and sample information on WhatsApp.
* Guide the customer to visit the showroom, office, website, or Instagram page when required.
* **Coordination With Sales Team**
* Forward qualified leads to the concerned sales person.
* Share complete lead details with the sales team.
* Follow up with the sales person to know the status of the lead.
* **CRM / Data Entry**
* Update all lead details in CRM, Excel, or company software.
* Maintain proper records of calls, follow\-ups, customer responses, and next action dates.
* Ensure no lead is missed or left unattended.
* **Follow\-Up Management**
* Call customers again as per follow\-up schedule.
* Send reminders, product details, and meeting confirmations.
* Keep regular contact until the lead is closed, rejected, or handed over fully to sales.
* **Daily Reporting**
* Submit daily call reports.
* Report total calls made, connected calls, hot leads, follow\-ups, and converted leads.
* Inform management about common customer questions, objections, and feedback.

Required Skills

* Good communication skills in **Gujarati, Hindi, and basic English**
* Polite and professional speaking style
* Basic sales understanding
* Comfortable with calling, WhatsApp, and CRM/Excel entry
* Ability to follow up repeatedly without hesitation
* Good listening skills
* Basic understanding of interiors, paints, wall textures, or construction products will be an advantage

Qualification

* Minimum 12th pass / Graduate preferred
* 1–3 years of experience in telecalling, lead calling, customer support, or inside sales preferred
* Freshers with good communication skills can also apply

Work Experience Preferred

* Telecalling for interior products, paints, real estate, construction material, furniture, tiles, or related industries
* Experience handling Facebook, Instagram, Google, or website leads

Performance Expectations

The Tele Caller will be expected to:

* Call every new lead on time
* Maintain proper follow\-up records
* Increase the percentage of connected and qualified leads
* Support the sales team with genuine and complete lead information
* Help improve conversion from digital marketing campaigns

Key Performance Indicators

* Number of calls made daily
* Number of leads connected
* Number of qualified leads generated
* Number of follow\-ups completed
* Number of showroom visits / sales meetings arranged
* Number of leads converted through coordination with sales team
* Accuracy of CRM / lead data entry

 The India Operations ER team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfilment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees and associates that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, ER team’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories.
   

  

 INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience.
   

  

 As an Employee Relations Manager (ERM), you will drive positive employee relations and enable positive associate and employee experience in your region and line of business.

Successful candidate will be able to independently own and drive broad spectrum of employee relations programs and handle issues. This role requires considerable domestic travel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The individual will be responsible for the following types of proactive work:
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Communicate Effectively: Rapidly produce high\-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and recommends solutions; design and deliver highly\-engaging training sessions. Partner to engage in continuous improvement in communication vehicles and practices

 The individual also will work on critical employee relations issues that are crisis oriented and typically can only be successfully completed with limited time while exercising judgment. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent

* Master's degree in Human Resources Management or a related field
* 6\+ years of relevant professional experience
