title: Network Engineer
description:
**Network Engineer \- Data Center Operations** 




 Experience\-2 to 5 years
 



 Location: Noida
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 Network Engineer is responsible for delivering onsite network deployment, installation, and maintenance services. The role involves performing rack and stack activities, IOS upgrades, and device health validation for a range of network infrastructure components including switches, routers, servers, and wireless access points.
 



  





 This position requires hands\-on technical expertise, attention to detail, and effective coordination with remote support and client teams to ensure smooth execution and compliance with service delivery standards and SLAs.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Onsite Deployment \& Installation (Rack and Stack)** 



* Perform rack and stack installation of network and server hardware including switches, routers, servers, and access points (APs).
* Install SFP modules, stacking cables, power cords, and network uplinks as per design and project requirements.
* Ensure proper labeling, cable management, and adherence to rack design and airflow guidelines.
* Mount devices (up to 3 meters in height) securely and safely, following all EHS standards.



**Device Configuration \& IOS Upgrade** 



* Execute IOS/firmware upgrades and confirm version compliance post\-upgrade.
* Validate successful device boot, configuration integrity, and module recognition.
* Collaborate with remote engineers for configuration application, testing, and verification.



**Device Health Check \& Validation (POST)** 



* Conduct Power\-On Self\-Test (POST) validation for each installed device.
* Verify interface status, module health, LED indicators, and power redundancy.
* Identify and report any faulty or non\-functional hardware for immediate escalation.



**Wireless Access Point (AP) Installation** 



* Mount and connect APs at designated locations according to deployment plans.
* Ensure secure installation, correct positioning, and power/connectivity validation.
* Note: This role does not include site surveys or signal validation—installation only.



**Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate logs of all installed devices, serial numbers, and cable details.
* Update rack elevation diagrams and cable matrices post\-installation.
* Provide before\-and\-after photos and summary reports for delivery validation and audit purposes.



**Coordination \& Communication** 



* Coordinate with remote implementation, NOC, and project teams for connectivity testing and verification.
* Communicate installation status, issues, and dependencies proactively.
* Escalate site access, hardware, or environmental issues promptly to the Service Delivery Manager.



**Client Interaction \& SLA Accountability** 



* Act as the onsite technical representative, maintaining professional communication with the client during installation and testing activities.
* Ensure all activities are executed within defined SLAs, maintaining adherence to schedule, quality, and operational standards.
* Participate in service review meetings when required, presenting progress updates, risks, and completion reports.
* Document client feedback and ensure action plans are executed for continual service improvement.
* Uphold client satisfaction through transparent communication, professional conduct, and technical accuracy in all deliverables.



**Technical Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with Cisco, Fortinet, and Aruba network devices (Switches, Routers, Wireless APs).
* Knowledge of L2/L3 networking concepts such as VLANs, trunking, link aggregation, and routing fundamentals.
* Experience with firmware/IOS upgrades, device health checks, and configuration validation.
* Familiar with rack standards, structured cabling, grounding, and ESD compliance.
* Ability to interpret network diagrams, rack layouts, and cable schedules.
* Understanding of ITIL service operations and SLA\-driven delivery frameworks.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in on\-site network installation or service delivery engineering.
* Practical experience with Cisco IOS or equivalent enterprise network operating systems.
* Proven track record in executing rack installation, IOS upgrades, and post\-installation validation.
* Experience with ServiceNow or ITSM ticketing systems preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.



**Physical \& Site Requirements** 



* Ability to lift and install equipment (up to 10–15 kg).
* Comfortable working at installation heights up to 3 meters.
* Compliance with all site safety, ESD, and physical handling protocols.



**Key Deliverables** 



* Successful rack and stack of network devices per design and compliance standards.
* Verified device health and validated IOS upgrades.
* Comprehensive post\-installation documentation and photo evidence.
* 100% SLA adherence for onsite service activities.
* Client acknowledgment of service completion and satisfaction.

**About Salesforce**

The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 Technical writers at Salesforce don’t just document products. They shape how customers understand, adopt, and succeed with them.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Writer, you will own and drive content for key product areas, designing scalable, high\-impact content across product and help experiences. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, UX designers, and other writers to ensure customers get the right information, in the right context, at the right time.
   

  

 We are evolving from traditional structured authoring (DITA/XML) to a modern docs\-as\-code approach (Git \+ Markdown), alongside AI\-assisted content workflows. This role is ideal for someone who can create scalable, high\-quality content, contribute to product decisions, and improve how content works across product and AI\-driven environments.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own and drive content for product areas or feature sets, from planning through delivery
* Design and deliver in\-product guidance, help content, and learning experiences (including Trailhead)
* Create modular, reusable, and structured content that scales across surfaces
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and UX to ensure content is accurate and ready at launch
* Influence product and UX decisions through a strong customer perspective
* Identify gaps in the customer journey and proactively design content solutions
* Use data and feedback to improve content effectiveness and customer outcomes
* Work within evolving content systems, including a transition from DITA/XML to docs\-as\-code (Git \+ Markdown)
* Use AI tools to accelerate content creation and design content optimized for AI\-driven experiences (search, assistants, and automation)
* Contribute to and help evolve team standards, processes, and content models


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 5\-10 years of experience creating technical content for software products
* Proven ability to design content for end\-to\-end user journeys, not just individual topics
* Strong writing skills with the ability to make complex concepts clear and approachable
* Ability to quickly learn and explain complex technologies
* Experience working in structured authoring environments (DITA/XML preferred)
* Familiarity with source control systems (Git, Perforce, or similar)
* Openness to and interest in working with docs\-as\-code workflows (Git, Markdown)
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., LLMs) to improve content creation, editing, or scalability
* Ability to think in systems and create content that is reusable, structured, and adaptable across surfaces
* Experience working in Agile development environments
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to influence cross\-functional teams
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in docs\-as\-code environments using Git\-based workflows and Markdown
* Experience designing content for in\-product experiences or embedded help
* Familiarity with content systems that support personalization, dynamic delivery, or AI\-assisted experiences
* Ability to read and understand code, and create simple code samples where needed
* Experience with Salesforce products or CRM platforms
* Familiarity with web technologies such as HTML/CSS or modern UI frameworks


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Business Analyst – Life Insurance Domain
description:
**Location:** 
 PAN India (Chennai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Gurgaon, Noida, Mumbai, Delhi)
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 8–10 Years
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with strong expertise in Life Insurance applications and digital platforms. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience working in Agile environments and possess a strong understanding of life insurance business processes and technology solutions.
   

  

 This role involves collaborating with business and technical stakeholders to ensure business requirements are accurately translated into effective technology solutions while aligning with operational and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Requirements Gathering \& Documentation**
* Conduct workshops, stakeholder discussions, and requirement\-gathering sessions.
* Analyze and document business requirements, user stories, use cases, and process flows.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and functional specifications for system enhancements and product implementations.


 Process Analysis \& Improvement
   

  

* Analyze existing life insurance processes such as:
+ Policy Administration
+ Claims Processing
+ Underwriting
+ New Business

* Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and automation opportunities.
* Design future\-state business processes to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.


 Solution Design \& Collaboration
   

  

* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Collaborate with development teams to translate business requirements into functional solutions.
* Provide clarity on business processes and functional expectations during solution design.


 Testing \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Prepare test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Validate implemented solutions against business requirements and expected outcomes.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Manage and prioritize requirements across multiple stakeholders.
* Provide regular project updates, communicate business impacts, and manage expectations effectively.


**Required Skills \& Experience** 
  

  

* 7\+ years of overall experience as a Business Analyst.
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience in Life Insurance projects, preferably within US insurance environments.
* Strong experience in:
+ Requirement gathering
+ Stakeholder workshops
+ BRD/FRD documentation
+ User stories and process flows

* Good understanding of Life Insurance domains including:
+ Policy Administration
+ Claims
+ Underwriting
+ New Business

* Experience in process analysis, gap analysis, and process improvement initiatives.
* Ability to work closely with business and technical teams to deliver functional solutions.
* Hands\-on experience in:
+ UAT coordination
+ Test case preparation
+ Requirement validation

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills.
* Experience working in Agile and/or Waterfall delivery models.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working on enterprise\-scale digital transformation or insurance modernization projects.
* Exposure to workflow automation and business process optimization initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.


 Work Model \& Shift Details
   

  

* Work Model: Hybrid / Remote
* Shift Timing: 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM
* Support may involve rotational or extended business\-hour coverage based on project requirements.


**Additional Requirements**
* Immediate to 15 days notice period preferred.
* Strong communication skills are mandatory.
* Candidates should demonstrate stable career progression and long\-term project ownership experience.
* Interview Process: 3 Rounds
* Expected Hiring Timeline: 10–15 Days


**Compensation**
* Compensation will be aligned with experience, current compensation, interview feedback, and internal benchmarking standards.

description:

As an analytics\-first payload innovator, we specialize in building next\-generation, high\-resolution, multispectral payloads with edge computing and wide coverage capabilities.

 We are looking for a motivated Embedded Software Intern to join our engineering team. In this role, you will work on the Processing System (PS) side of AMD SoCs, developing low\-level software that interfaces with custom hardware logic for high\-reliability, space\-qualified systems.
   

  

 This role is ideal for students or fresh graduates who want hands\-on exposure to embedded systems, heterogeneous computing, networking, and hardware\-software integration in real\-world aerospace applications.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and debug embedded C/C\+\+ applications for ARM Cortex\-A and Cortex\-R processors using AMD Vitis IDE
* Configure Board Support Packages (BSPs) using XSA hardware hand\-off files
* Interface with custom IP cores and hardware accelerators through AXI\-based communication
* Build and deploy boot images including FSBL, bitstreams, and applications for hardware validation
* Implement and optimize Ethernet communication using LwIP
* Perform packet\-level debugging and network troubleshooting using Wireshark
* Assist in debugging software\-hardware interactions using JTAG debuggers, GDB, and logic analyzers
* Support automation and testing activities using Python scripts
* Collaborate with hardware and FPGA teams during system integration and validation


**Qualifications**
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields

* Basic understanding of bare\-metal or RTOS\-based software development
* Familiarity with TCP/IP networking fundamentals
* Hands\-on exposure to debugging tools such as GDB, JTAG, or logic analyzers
* Understanding of embedded system fundamentals including interrupts, memory mapping, and ARM architecture
* Basic Python scripting skills


**Preferred Skills**
* Familiarity with AMD Vitis unified software platform
* Understanding of AXI4 interfaces and SoC architectures
* Knowledge of cache coherency and hardware\-software interaction concepts
* Experience working with FPGA\-based systems or custom hardware IPs
* Prior academic or personal projects in embedded systems, networking, or low\-level software development
* Ability to read and interpret Technical Reference Manuals (TRMs) and hardware documentation


**What You’ll Gain**
* Hands\-on experience with AMD SoC\-based embedded platforms
* Exposure to real\-world aerospace and space\-qualified embedded systems
* Practical experience in networking, driver development, and system integration
* Mentorship from experienced embedded and FPGA engineers
* Opportunity to work on high\-reliability software and hardware validation workflows


**Selection Process**

The Recruitment Manager owns the full hiring funnel across all four businesses, with the school (ABSS) as the primary focus (roughly 60–70% of the role). You will build sourcing pipelines, run searches end\-to\-end, and become the person who can reliably bring in the right candidate for any open role across the group, on time and within budget.

Key responsibilities

* Work with the Principal, business heads, and the Owner to clarify what each open role actually needs — qualifications, experience, behaviours, must\-haves vs nice\-to\-haves — and convert that into a sharp JD.
* Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline for each business.
* Phone screens, written assessments where relevant (especially demo lessons for teachers), and shortlisting against role criteria.
* Run the interview process end\-to\-end — scheduling, briefing interviewers, preparing structured interview guides, collecting feedback, and keeping candidates warm through the process.
* For teaching roles, coordinate demo classes — finding a suitable class and date, briefing the candidate, organising observers, collecting evaluations.
* Always do them, including a phone call to the previous school or employer. Document outcomes.
* Prepare offer letters, negotiate within sanctioned bands, handle counter\-offers, and close. Manage the period between offer and joining actively — most no\-shows happen here.

Required qualifications and experience

* Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA / PGDM in HR or equivalent preferred
* 4–7 years in recruitment, with at least 2 years on school/teacher hiring strongly preferred
* Strong written and spoken English
* Comfortable using a computer and MS Office regularly; familiar with hiring platforms such as LinkedIn, Indeed, and Naukri.com

**Multitasking Ability**: Capability to manage multiple tasks and work effectively under pressure.

**What Working at EY Offers:**


At EY, we are committed to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do is as diverse as they are. You will engage in inspiring and meaningful projects, with a focus on education and coaching alongside practical experience to support your personal development. We value our employees and empower you to take control of your growth with an individual progression plan. **Who we are looking for**


The Managing Director, India Regional Lead provides senior regional leadership for the Finance Data \& AI Office (DART) in India. This role partners closely with global and regional leadership to ensure high\-quality, consistent service delivery aligned to DART’s two core enterprise services: (1\) Providing Certified Data and (2\) Enabling Finance Transformation for stakeholders across Finance, Risk, and Treasury.


The role is accountable for driving execution discipline, service delivery excellence, and alignment across the regional portfolio, while ensuring adherence to global strategy, enterprise standards, and governance expectations. Operating within a matrixed organization, the India Regional Lead establishes a strong DART leadership presence in the region, works closely with designated local managers and functional leaders, and acts as a visible role model for Finance transformation—bringing energy, influence, and a proactive leadership approach to mobilize teams, drive momentum, and enable measurable business outcomes.

**Why this role is important to us**


DART operates as a service\-oriented organization. All functional capabilities—including Data Products, Data Governance, Data Solutions, Automation, Analytics, and AI Enablement—are aligned to two core services:

* Provide Certified Data – delivering trusted, governed, high\-quality data products that support enterprise and regulatory needs.
* Enable Finance Transformation – enabling Finance through modern platforms, analytics, automation, and AI to improve efficiency, insight, and decision\-making.

**What you will be responsible for**


Service Leadership \& Internal Client Focus

* Serve as the senior regional leader responsible for delivery excellence across DART’s core services.
* Promote a strong service mindset across regional teams, emphasizing quality, reliability, timeliness, and value delivered to internal clients.
* Ensure clear service ownership, expectations, and success measures are consistently applied across initiatives.
* Act as a senior escalation point for service delivery issues impacting Finance stakeholders.


Regional Portfolio Accountability \& Delivery Management

* Provide end\-to\-end oversight of the regional DART portfolio, ensuring initiatives align to defined service objectives and outcomes.
* Establish a consistent execution and review cadence, including risk, dependency, and issue management.
* Identify cross\-cutting risks, interdependencies, and capacity constraints, coordinating mitigation plans with functional leaders.


Strategy, Governance \& Operating Model Alignment

* Support implementation of the global Finance Data \& AI strategy through a service\-based delivery model.
* Ensure regional delivery adheres to enterprise standards for data quality, governance, controls, and regulatory readiness.
* Promote scalable, reusable solutions within established governance and risk frameworks.


Leadership Presence, Culture \& Continuous Improvement

* Establish a strong leadership presence for DART in India through active engagement and partnership.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Balance agility and innovation with appropriate risk management and controls.


Partnership with Local Management

* Work closely with designated local managers, respecting established people and HR accountability structures.
* Provide leadership, coaching, and escalation support without assuming direct line management authority.


Stakeholder Engagement \& Representation

* Build strong partnerships with Finance, Risk, Treasury, and Technology stakeholders.
* Represent DART India in regional and global leadership and governance forums.


Measures of Success

* Consistent, high\-quality delivery of certified data and Finance transformation services.
* Strong service delivery discipline, transparency, and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Demonstrated adherence to governance, quality, and control standards.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

* Significant senior leadership experience in a complex, global, matrixed organization.
* Experience leading large\-scale Finance transformation initiatives.
* Proven experience with service\-oriented delivery models or execution portfolios.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise data management, regulatory data expectations (e.g., BCBS 239\), and control\-driven environments.
* Exposure to modern data, analytics, automation, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving cross\-functional alignment.

**Additional Requirement**


This role operates through influence, service stewardship, and alignment and does not independently exercise employment authority outside formal reporting lines.

* Knowledge of Workday and other HR systems in the domain of Payroll and Benefits.

title: Payroll Specialist
description:
**Who we are**



Moniepoint Group is the fastest growing Fintech in Africa, as just ranked by Financial Times in 2024\. Our mission is to drive financial inclusion and bring happiness to hundreds of millions of small businesses and individuals in Africa, by building Africa's all\-in\-one financial ecosystem, empowering businesses and their customers with seamless payment, banking, credit, and management tools.



We are Nigeria’s biggest merchant acquirer, and one of the biggest digital banks, with over 15 million customers, and 3,500\+ team members. We are on an exciting journey of growth, and we are now looking for a passionate, experienced people leader to build and drive our global talent and performance management strategy across the entire company.


### **Job Purpose**



The Payroll Specialist provides essential, high\-precision support in delivering timely and accurate payroll across Moniepoint’s global markets. you will ensure that our international workforce is paid accurately and on time. You are the guardian of payroll data integrity, a key point of contact for employee queries, and a champion of compliant financial reporting.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Global Payroll Execution \& Validation
	+ End\-to\-End Processing: Prepare, validate, and record payroll inputs across all active platforms in India and UK, ensuring local nuances and regional labor laws are respected.
	+ Accuracy \& Reconciliation: Execute rigorous monthly cycles, including variance reviews, accuracy checks, and reconciliation of payroll feeders to the general ledger.
	+ HRIS Synchronization: Audit and validate that employee lifecycle changes (hires, terminations, promotions) are mirrored accurately between HRIS and payroll systems.  
	
	Partner with business leaders to operationalize people plans, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and talent priorities
* Compliance, SOX \& Statutory Oversight
	+ SOX Compliance \& Controls: Maintain and adhere to SOX\-compliant workflows, ensuring all payroll activities follow established internal controls, approval hierarchies, and strict audit trails.
	+ Statutory Submissions: Support the timely filing of PAYE, pensions, taxes, and other local statutory requirements across all operating jurisdictions.
	+ Audit Readiness: Assist in producing detailed schedules and documentation for internal and external audits, ensuring a "zero\-findings" environment.
* Stakeholder Management \& Optimization
	+ Employee Experience: Respond to payroll\-related inquiries with professional clarity, maintaining high satisfaction through timely and empathetic communication.
	+ Third\-Party Management: Coordinate with payroll providers and third\-party vendors to ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
	+ Process Improvement: Troubleshoot data discrepancies and collaborate with HRIS and Finance teams to automate manual tasks and maintain updated process documentation (SOPs).

### **Qualifications**


* Experience: 4 or more years of dedicated payroll or HR operations experience in a professional environment.
* Systems Fluency: Hands\-on familiarity with global payroll platforms such as Payfit, Gusto, Monnify, Razorpay, or similar cloud\-based tools.
* Analytical Prowess: Strong attention to detail and advanced confidence working with spreadsheets, complex data sets, and financial numbers.
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret data trends.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* International Scope: Prior experience supporting multi\-entity and multi\-currency payroll environments.
* Regional Expertise: A basic understanding of payroll requirements across India, UK.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with maintaining internal controls (SOX) within a payroll operations context.


**About You**


* Precise \& Dependable: You are organized by nature and take deep pride in "getting it right the first time."
* Effective Communicator: You translate complex payroll data into clear, helpful support for colleagues and employees alike.
* Growth\-Oriented: You are eager to deepen your technical payroll expertise across multiple platforms and stay ahead of global compliance trends.
* Trustworthy: You handle sensitive data with the highest level of confidentiality and professional integrity.


**What to expect in the hiring process**


* A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
* A 60 minute interview with the hiring manager, Senior Manager, Lead Global Payroll Operations and Reporting.
* An interview with our Head of People Operations


*Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.*

Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will join our early talent and recruitment team to support campus and early career hiring in India. You will work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and external partners to attract and engage students and early professionals. We value curiosity, collaboration, and a growth mindset. This role offers clear learning paths, hands\-on experience in recruitment operations, and the chance to help shape how we find and welcome future colleagues. You will help unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: \- Support end\-to\-end recruitment activities for early talent programs, including sourcing, screening and candidate communications. \- Coordinate campus and virtual events, manage logistics, and support employer branding activities. \- Maintain recruitment systems, job postings and candidate records with attention to quality. \- Prepare materials, manage shipments and maintain inventory for campus and event use. \- Track recruitment expenses and support timely reporting and invoice reconciliation. \- Build and maintain strong relationships with universities, vendors and internal stakeholders. Why You? This role is on\-site in India. The position will involve occasional travel for campus events. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals \- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology or related field, or equivalent experience. \- 1–3 years of experience in recruitment, campus relations, or HR coordination. \- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. \- Comfortable working with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and common collaboration tools. \- Good organisational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities. \- Comfortable interacting with a range of stakeholders, from students to hiring managers. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus \- Experience managing campus events, information sessions or virtual booths. \- Familiarity with applicant tracking systems or recruiting platforms. \- Experience handling budgets, invoices and travel or shipping logistics. \- Previous work within a large or matrix organisation. \- Ability to travel nationally for events when required. \- Interest in early talent strategy, employer branding or recruitment operations. What success looks like You will contribute to a smooth candidate experience and an efficient recruitment process. You will help grow our early talent pipeline and strengthen partnerships with universities. You will learn practical recruiting skills and take on increasing responsibility. How to apply If this role excites you, please submit your CV and a short note telling us why you want to join our team and how your experience fits the role. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people who value learning and collaboration to apply.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;
**Why GSK?**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.


People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Job Number**26059792

**Schedule**Full Time  

**Located Remotely?**N  

**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

  



Assists in carrying out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she assists in delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

  



**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  



**Education and Experience**


* High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


OR


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.

  



**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

  



**Assisting in Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**


* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.


* Assists in establishing and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.


* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.


* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.


* Assists in monitoring candidate identification and selection process.


* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

  



**Assisting in Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**


* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.


* Assists with unemployment claim activity reports.


* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented, as needed.

  



**Assisting in Managing Employee Development**


* Assists with departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.


* Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.


* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs


* Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

  



**Assisting in Maintaining Employee Relations**


* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).


* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner


* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi\-Property Director of Human Resources.


* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

  



**Assisting in Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.


* Assists with ensuring medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.


* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).


* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.


* Assists with ensuring all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.


* Assists with periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.


* Assists with managing Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.

description:

Join our high\-performing Talent Acquisition team as a Recruiting Associate, where your expertise will help attract and engage talent.




Drive impactful talent acquisition for Firmwide Functions by delivering strategic recruitment solutions and building high\-performing teams.


**Job Summary**


As a Recruiter within Firmwide Functions/Corporate \- Risk Management, you will be responsible for managing the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle for roles across departments. You will partner closely with business leaders to deliver strategic talent acquisition solutions, drive candidate engagement, and support broader talent management initiatives. Your ability to build strong relationships, provide consultative guidance, and deliver a diverse slate of candidates will be key to your success.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead the recruitment process from sourcing to offer acceptance for Firmwide Functions roles \- Risk management Business, ranging from Analyst to Vice President level.
* Conduct requirement intake meetings with hiring managers, advising on recruitment best practices, controls, and policies.
* Identify, evaluate, and present qualified candidates, adjusting strategies based on feedback and market trends.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, influencing hiring decisions and managing expectations throughout the process.
* Educate candidates on career opportunities, firm culture and benefits to ensure successful offer closures.
* Develop and implement strategies to attract and present a diverse slate of candidates across skills.
* Study and presentmarket data and competitive insights to influence hiring decisions and talent strategies.
* Contribute to projects such as market mapping and confidential talent search initiatives.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Demonstrated 4 \+ years of experience in full life cycle recruiting, experience in Risk Management is required
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple searches and deliver exceptional client service.
* Excellent relationship management and communication skills with both clients and candidates.
* Proficiency in direct sourcing and engaging passive candidates.
* Knowledge of compensation structures and the ability to negotiate complex offers.
* Prior experience using PowerPoint, Excel and Word to analyze and present hiring and market data.

Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  


Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we’re setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.  

  

Human Resources plays a critical role in driving the employee experience, shaping the firm’s culture and building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are a strategic partner to the business — working with leaders across the firm to hire, develop and retain the best people and help meet business goals. Together, we foster a work environment in which our people are supported, feel like they belong and are able to make an impact through their work. We develop and deliver a suite of products and services that help make JPMorgan Chase an employer of choice and drive our business forward.

title: Customer Support Manager - Talent
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the Role**
------------------


As a Customer Support Manager at Rippling, you will lead a high\-performing team responsible for delivering exceptional support to our customers. You will act as the point of contact (POC) for all actions and domains within your team, ensuring efficient operations, seamless collaboration, and outstanding customer experiences. This role demands a proactive, strategic mindset combined with hands\-on leadership skills to drive team performance and process improvements in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

  

You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Customer Support and play a pivotal role in aligning team goals with Rippling's broader objectives while focusing heavily on talent enablement and team development.

 **What you will do**

**Team Leadership and People Management:**

* Act as the primary POC for your team, overseeing all operational aspects.
* Lead, mentor, and support team leads in their respective roles, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence.
* Provide coaching, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities to team members.
* Handle team scheduling, attendance management, and adherence to ensure optimal staffing coverage.
* Drive the onboarding and development of early\-career employees, including campus hires and freshers.

 **Operational Management and Performance:**

* Monitor and drive team productivity, ensuring performance metrics are met or exceeded.
* Track adherence to SLAs, response times, and quality benchmarks, addressing any gaps proactively.
* Analyze team performance data and trends to identify areas for improvement and implement solutions.

 **Enablement and Issue Resolution:**

* Proactively recognize potential issues in customer interactions or workflows and drive timely resolutions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Tech, Product, and Operations, to address and resolve complex customer issues.
* Design training or enablement programs to improve team proficiency.
* Serve as a conduit of information between the Customer Support team and senior management.

 **Customer Experience Improvement:**

* Identify patterns in customer feedback and operational inefficiencies, providing actionable insights for process optimization.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to suggest enhancements and stay updated on product developments.
* Assist in creating or updating knowledge base articles to empower customers with self\-service solutions.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* **Experience:** **6–9 years** of experience in customer support or customer\-facing teams .
* **Leadership Skills:** **Minimum 3–5 years of mandatory people management experience**, with a proven ability to develop teams through coaching and performance management.
* **Functional Must\-Haves:** **Hands\-on exposure to training or enablement programs** and experience managing the development of early\-career cohorts (campus hires/freshers).
* **Persona:** High ownership, initiative, and a **people\-oriented approach.**
* **Technical Proficiency:** Familiarity with customer support platforms and HR or IT systems (preferred).
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills—clear, concise, and empathetic.
* **Adaptability:** **Must\-have prior Night Shift** experience \& Flexibility to work in **US time zones** and handle evolving priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Customer\-First Mindset:** A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences

 **NOTE:**

**This role requires you to work in the US timezone.**

**Work Model:** This is a **hybrid role** based in our **Bangalore office** (3 days per week).

description:

**Location:** Pune

**Position Overview**


We are seeking a skilled **SAP Callidus/Success Factors Incentive Compensation Support Specialist** to provide technical and functional support for our incentive compensation management processes. This role will ensure accurate calculation, reporting, and administration of sales compensation plans using SAP Callidus (SAP Commissions). The ideal candidate will have experience in troubleshooting, configuration, and end\-user support within the SAP Callidus platform.

* **System Support \& Maintenance**

* Perform configuration changes and updates to compensation plans as required.

* Ensure data integrity between SAP Callidus and upstream/downstream systems (CRM, ERP, HR systems).
* **Compensation Plan Administration**

* Support monthly/quarterly commission runs and payout processes.
* Generate and distribute compensation reports and dashboards.
* Support the Advanced workflow application.

* 1 year of experience supporting SAP Callidus (SAP Commissions) or similar incentive compensation systems.
* Strong understanding of sales compensation processes and data flows.
* **Technical Skills:**
* Proficiency in SAP Callidus configuration and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with SQL, data analysis, and reporting tools.
* Experience with integration between SAP Callidus and CRM/ERP systems.
* **Soft Skills:**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Exposure to Agile methodology and project management tools.

title: Office Executive — HR, Admin & Accounts
description:
About Wowelse

Wowelse is a fast\-growing branding agency in Coimbatore built on creativity, speed, and smart execution. Behind every great creative team is a solid operations backbone. We're looking for one sharp, reliable **Office Executive** who can own HR, Admin, and Accounts — all three — and keep the engine running smoothly every single day.

Why This Role Exists

As Wowelse scales, we need one dependable person who sits at the center of our operations. This isn't a siloed desk job — you'll touch people, process, and money. You'll be the go\-to person for everything that keeps the agency organized, compliant, and financially healthy.

What You'll Do

**HR (Human Resources)**

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment — job postings, resume screening, interview coordination, and offer letters
* Manage onboarding and offboarding processes for all team members
* Maintain employee records, attendance registers, and leave management
* Draft HR policies, appointment letters, and employment contracts
* Address day\-to\-day employee queries and support a positive work culture
* Ensure HR compliance with applicable labour laws and regulations

**Admin (Administration)**

* Manage day\-to\-day office operations — supplies, maintenance, and vendor coordination
* Handle courier, documentation, and filing systems — physical and digital

Do you love problem\-solving and helping others? We are looking for a driven and detail\-orientated Payments Analyst to join our Payment Operations team. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end health of our pay\-in and pay\-out ecosystems — resolving customer escalations, monitoring system performance, and partnering cross\-functionally to build scalable, fraud\-resilient payment workflows. Beyond day\-to\-day operations, you will play an active role in evolving our reduction of customer recontacts and driving measurable efficiency gains. This is an exciting opportunity suited for a motivated individual eager to deepen their expertise in fintech payments.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Payout Operations**

* Investigate delayed, failed, or returned payout transactions and coordinate resolution with financial institution partners.
* Manage payout queue health, flag anomalies, and ensure SLA adherence for all payout types.
* Support users escalated edge cases requiring manual review and account\-level action.

**Systems Monitoring \& Operational Excellence**

* Monitor real\-time health for payment processing systems and act as first responder for system\-wide disruptions or processing failures.
* Use back\-office tools to execute account\-level actions, order adjustments, and manual overrides with precision.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Customer Support**

* Serve as the subject matter expert for payments\-related escalations from customer support, operations, and business teams.

Do you thrive on investigation, pattern recognition, and protecting both customers and the business from financial loss? We are looking for a meticulous and analytically driven Chargebacks Analyst to join our Payment Operations team. In this role, you will own the full chargeback and dispute lifecycle — from initial retrieval requests through representation— working directly with card networks, acquiring banks, and internal stakeholders to recover revenue and minimize losses. Beyond dispute resolution, you will play a key role in identifying fraud trends, strengthening our prevention posture, and building scalable processes that protect the integrity of our payments ecosystem. This is an entry\-level position with significant growth potential for candidates who combine curiosity with operational rigor.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Dispute \& Chargeback Management**

* Own the end\-to\-end chargeback lifecycle across all card networks (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover \& PayPal) including retrieval requests, first chargebacks and second chargebacks.
* Prepare and submit timely, evidence\-backed representment packages to maximize win rates and recover revenue on behalf of the business.
* Respond to retrieval requests and fulfillment inquiries within network\-mandated timeframes to prevent automatic losses.
* Triage incoming disputes by reason code, dispute stage, and financial exposure to prioritize caseload effectively.
* Track and manage all open cases within the platform, ensuring no case ages past its response deadline.
* Analyze dispute outcomes to identify patterns in win/loss rates and refine representment strategies accordingly.

**Fraud Investigation \& Loss Prevention**

* Investigate True Fraud, first\-party misuse, and policy abuse patterns surfaced through chargeback filings and user behavior signals.
* Collaborate with the Risk and Trust \& Safety teams to take enforcement actions on confirmed fraudulent accounts including blocks, account restrictions, and fund holds.
* Flag high\-frequency or high\-value dispute clusters to leadership as potential coordinated fraud or network\-level compromise events.
* Support pre\-emptive refund decisions where accepting a dispute is more cost\-effective than representment, balancing recovery goals with operational efficiency.
* Maintain detailed case notes and fraud intelligence logs to support pattern analysis and future investigations.

**Process Improvement \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Contribute to the development and maintenance of chargeback SOPs, decision trees, and representment templates.
* Partner with Engineering to surface friction points in the buyer and seller experience that contribute to dispute volumes.
* Provide operational input during payment processor or chargeback tool evaluations and onboarding.
* Collaborate with Customers to resolve escalated user\-facing dispute queries and communicate expected resolution timelines.
* Proactively share chargeback trend intelligence with Fraud \& Risk and Leadership to inform strategic decisions.

**PERFORMANCE MILESTONES**

**Within 6 Months**

* Develop a thorough understanding of chargeback reason codes, dispute stages, and card network rules across Visa, Mastercard, Amex, PayPal and Discover.
* Independently manage a full caseload of disputes end\-to\-end with minimal supervisory oversight.
* Build proficiency with the chargeback management platform and back\-office tools to execute account and order\-level actions.
* Meet or exceed defined SLA targets for response timeliness, representment submission, and case closure rates.
* Proactively surface identified fraud patterns, dispute trends, and risks to the broader team.

**Within 12\+ Months**

* Exceed all 6\-month benchmarks and responsibilities.
* Lead or contribute to at least two process improvement initiatives that measurably reduce dispute volume or improve win rates.
* Develop deep expertise in one or more dispute categories (e.g.retrieval requests, first chargebacks and second chargebacks).
* Own ongoing reporting cycles and proactively identify insights that drive operational and strategic decisions.

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Experience \& Education**

* 1–3 years of experience in chargeback operations, dispute resolution, payment operations, or a related financial services role. Freshers with strong analytical aptitude are encouraged to apply.
* Familiarity with card network dispute frameworks (Visa Claims Resolution, Mastercard Dispute Resolution, Amex Dispute Management) is a strong advantage.
* Experience using chargeback or dispute management platforms (Chargebacks911, Midigator, Verifi, Ethoca, or processor\-native tools) preferred.
* Prior exposure to fraud investigation workflows or e\-commerce risk operations is beneficial.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Exceptional attention to detail — accuracy in case documentation and financial reconciliation is non\-negotiable in this role.
* Strong analytical and investigative mindset with the ability to connect disparate data points into a coherent fraud or dispute narrative.
* Excellent written communication skills; able to draft clear, compelling representment arguments and partner\-facing correspondence.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage a high\-volume caseload under strict deadline pressure.
* Customer\-first mindset with empathy for users navigating frustrating payment disputes.
* Collaborative team player who actively contributes knowledge and takes initiative beyond the immediate scope of assigned cases.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets and interpreting processor statements, reconciliation reports, and chargeback dashboards.

**Nice to Have**

* Basic SQL or data querying skills for independent transaction\-level investigation and reporting.
* Exposure to marketplace or platform business models where buyer\-seller disputes are a primary chargeback driver.

title: Site Execution Engineer
description:
ARE YOU READY TO BUILD SOMETHING REAL?

This isn't a desk job where you show up, follow instructions, and clock out. This is a role for someone who wants to be in the field, get their hands dirty, and actually execute premium interior design projects from the ground up.

At Archiville Design Studio, we work on high\-end residential projects where quality, speed, and ownership matter above everything else. We're looking for a Site Execution Engineer who is sharp, energetic, and hungry to grow fast in the world of luxury interiors and premium construction.

If you've been looking for a role that actually challenges you, teaches you something new every day, and gives you real exposure to how top\-tier design studios operate — this is it.

—

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Site Execution Engineer at Archiville, you will be the eyes, hands, and brain on the ground. You'll be responsible for ensuring that what's designed in the studio is perfectly executed on site — with zero compromise on quality and zero tolerance for delays.

You'll work directly with leadership, coordinate with vendors and clients, manage timelines, solve problems in real\-time, and ensure that every project is delivered at the premium level our clients expect.

—

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Supervise and coordinate all on\-site activities for interior design and fit\-out projects
* Ensure day\-to\-day execution aligns with the design intent, material specifications, and timelines
* Coordinate with contractors, vendors, and suppliers to ensure timely material delivery and work completion
* Conduct regular quality checks and site inspections — and flag any issues before they become problems
* Communicate professionally with clients on\-site, managing their expectations and keeping them informed
* Maintain daily site reports, progress updates, and documentation
* Handle multiple moving parts simultaneously across different projects
* Problem\-solve on\-site with quick decisions and creative thinking
* Work closely with the design team to translate concepts into reality
* Ensure that every site is clean, safe, and organized at all times
* Travel locally to project sites as required

—

WHO SHOULD APPLY

We're not looking for someone with a fancy resume. We're looking for someone with the right energy and hunger.

Apply if you are:

* A fast learner who can pick up new things without being spoon\-fed
* Someone who takes ownership and doesn't wait to be told twice
* High on energy and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment
* Willing to travel locally across Bangalore for site visits
* Someone who genuinely cares about quality and details
* A strong communicator who can handle both workers on the ground and clients face\-to\-face
* Comfortable using basic tech tools for reporting and communication
* Passionate about interior design, architecture, or premium construction

Freshers and early\-career professionals are welcome. What matters more than experience is your attitude, speed, ownership mindset, and hunger to grow.

—

QUALIFICATIONS

* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field
* 0 to 3 years of experience (freshers with the right attitude are strongly encouraged to apply)
* Basic understanding of construction processes, interior fit\-out, and materials
* Strong communication skills in English and/or Kannada
* Willingness to be on\-site and physically active

—

WHAT YOU'LL EARN

* ₹15,000 to ₹22,000 per month (based on experience and skill)
* Performance incentives for timely and quality delivery
* Growth opportunities within the company

—

GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

This role is designed to grow with you. The right candidate will not stay at this level for long.

If you take ownership, learn fast, deliver quality, and prove yourself on the ground — you will grow into a Senior Execution Manager or Project Manager role within the studio. You'll get exposure to premium residential projects worth lakhs and crores, work closely with leadership, and build a career in one of the most exciting spaces in India right now — premium interior design and luxury living.

At Archiville, we promote from within. We back people who back themselves.

—

COMPANY CULTURE

Archiville Design Studio is not your average interior design firm. We're a young, ambitious, premium brand that moves fast, executes with precision, and builds experiences that clients remember for life.

Here, attitude matters more than age. Speed matters more than seniority. Ownership matters more than hierarchy.

We work hard, we grow fast, and we support each other. If you bring energy and commitment, you'll find that this place rewards you in ways a corporate job never will — with learning, exposure, responsibility, and real career growth.

—

HOW TO APPLY

If this role genuinely excites you, don't just apply — reach out.

Send your resume, a brief note about yourself, and why you think you're the right fit to: hr@archivillestudio.in

Subject line: Site Execution Engineer – \[Your Name]

You can also send a WhatsApp message to \+91 8147659069 saying:

READY TO EXECUTE – SITE ENGINEER APPLICATION

Then wait for our call.

We're building something premium. We need people who are serious about building with us.

Let's move fast. Let's build something great.

title: Research Associate
description:
**Job Title:**

Patent Research Associate (Fresher – Chemistry)

**Department:**

Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)

**Location:**

HO New Delhi

**Reporting To:**

IPR Head

**1\. Role Purpose**

The Patent Research Associate will support the development and strengthening of the organization’s Intellectual Property (IP) function by conducting scientific research, patent searches, and analysis aligned with ongoing R\&D activities.

The role is critical in identifying patentable innovations, generating strong technical documentation, and supporting patent filings across jurisdictions, while also contributing to cost optimization through in\-house patent research and analysis.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct **prior art searches** and patentability assessments for new chemical innovations
* Perform **scientific and technical analysis** to support patent drafting and filings
* Assist in **preparation, review, and drafting** of patent applications (provisional and complete specifications)
* Carry out **competitor analysis and patent landscape studies** to identify trends, gaps, and risks
* Support **freedom\-to\-operate (FTO) analysis** to minimize infringement risks
* Coordinate with internal R\&D teams to align research with **current technology and patent trends**
* Assist in **global patent filings**, including documentation and coordination with external agents
* Perform **patent translation** and technical interpretation of patent documents
* Maintain **accurate records** of patent deadlines, renewals, office actions, and prosecution status
* Track and report **IP portfolio performance and updates**
* Continuously monitor emerging technologies and competitor patent activity

**3\. Key Deliverables (KRAs)**

* Prior art and patent search reports
* Patentability assessment reports for R\&D projects
* Draft patent documents and technical inputs
* Competitor intelligence and patent landscape reports
* Timely support for patent filings (domestic \& international)
* Updated IP database with zero missed deadlines
* Periodic reports to R\&D and management on IP trends

**4\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of patent searches and analyses completed per month
* Turnaround time for prior art and patentability reports
* Number of R\&D projects evaluated for patent potential
* Number of patent applications supported/filed
* Adherence to patent deadlines (target: 100% compliance)
* Reduction in external IP research costs
* Quality and accuracy of reports and documentation
* Number of actionable insights generated from landscape analysis

**5\. Educational Qualification \& Skills**

**Education:**

* M.Sc. (Post Graduate) in Chemistry (mandatory)

**Skills Required:**

* Strong understanding of chemical concepts and scientific literature
* Basic knowledge of Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) and patents
* Analytical thinking and research skills
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Attention to detail and documentation accuracy
* Ability to interpret technical and legal patent documents
* Proficiency in MS Office and scientific databases (preferred)

**6\. Business Need \& Value Addition**

This role addresses the growing need for **structured IP support** within the organization by bridging the gap between R\&D and patent strategy.

It enables:

* Identification and protection of **innovative chemical research outputs**
* Development of a **strong and defensible patent portfolio**
* Reduction of **infringement risks** through proactive analysis
* Alignment of innovation with **market and technology trends**

**7\. Cost Saving \& Efficiency Impact**

This role will significantly reduce dependency on expensive external IP consultants and databases by building **in\-house patent research capabilities**.

**Key cost\-saving contributions include:**

* Reduction in **outsourced patent search and analysis costs**
* Early identification of non\-patentable ideas, saving **filing and legal expenses**
* Avoidance of **litigation risks and associated costs** through FTO analysis
* Efficient management of patent deadlines, preventing **penalties and lapses**
* Improved quality of filings, reducing **rework and prosecution costs**

Overall, the role contributes to **cost optimization while improving IP quality and efficiency**.

**9\. Conclusion**

The Patent Research Associate role is essential for building a **robust, cost\-effective, and globally competitive IP framework**. It ensures that innovation is strategically protected, business risks are minimized, and the organization’s long\-term value is enhanced through strong intellectual property assets.

**Applied Learning**

**People Management** 



* Serve as the first point of contact for employee relations, ensuring empathetic, confidential, and professional resolution with executive presence.

**Business \& Financial Acumen** 



* Forecast and plan manpower requirements based on operational needs and business forecasts.

**Leadership**

**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices** 



* Ensure compliance with local labour laws and maintain secure employee and medical records, auditing documentation, and adhering to privacy and safety regulations.

* Champion the implementation and enforcement of OH\&S standards across all operational areas.

**WORK EXPERIENCE**

title: HR Manager - GCC
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time GCC HR Manager in India we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your HR leadership and strategic expertise in a dynamic and innovative environment. You’ll work alongside collaborative and forward\-thinking teammates.
   

  

 You'll play a critical role in enabling the continued growth and transformation of the GCC by shaping and strengthening its people and culture foundations. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Sub Business Leaders, Department Leaders, Alstom HR Network, and Expertise in HR Centers), implement HR strategies aligned with business goals, and much more.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care of fostering a culture of leadership, accountability, and employee care by equipping line managers with the necessary human\-relations competencies, but also support the organization in building high\-performing teams through effective performance management, capability development, and succession planning.
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

* Providing strategic HR partnership to business leaders and implementing organization development and capability solutions.
* Ensuring compliance with policies, rules, and corporate HR strategies.
* Leading recruitment, workforce planning, and succession planning initiatives.
* Implementing Alstom’s performance management system and conducting annual people reviews.
* Driving employee engagement, retention programs, and wellness initiatives.
* Developing and implementing training programs to address competency gaps and enhance leadership capabilities.
* Ensuring timely reward, recognition, and career progression aligned with business needs.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to sustain a positive organizational culture and encourage internal mobility.
* Acting as a trusted advisor for employees on HR matters, conflict resolution, and inclusion.


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* MBA with a specialization in Human Resources.
* 10\+ years of HR experience in a similar industry or environment.
* Generalist HR management experience covering all areas of HR practice.
* Deep understanding of shared services, technology, and support function dynamics.
* Exposure to global HR practices, cross\-cultural environments, and matrixed reporting structures.
* Strong organizational, communication, and influencing skills with a business\-focused mindset.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Intercultural awareness and ability to handle conflict or crucial conversations effectively.


**Things you’ll enjoy** 
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines.
* Work with innovative HR technologies and processes.
* Collaborate with diverse, transverse teams and supportive colleagues.
* Contribute to impactful projects that shape the future of mobility.
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development through award\-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards leadership roles or specialized career paths within Alstom.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognizes your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Important to note**
 As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.
