description:
**Who We Are**
 At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. Do you want to be at the forefront of designing and implementing cutting\-edge network solutions? Within our Network Services team at Kyndryl, you will be the go\-to expert for providing top\-of\-the\-line technical solutions throughout the entire solution lifecycle. You will be responsible for creating local and wide\-area network solutions that utilize multiple platforms and protocols, ensuring that our customers have the best possible network infrastructure to support their business needs.
   

  

 Your skills in routers, networking controllers, bridges, and networking software will be essential as you troubleshoot network issues and coordinate with vendors to install the latest hardware and software, such as routers and switches. Not only will you help keep our customer’s networks running smoothly, but you will also work on project implementation, conduct project planning and cost analysis, and build proof\-of\-concept solutions with networking system technology.
   

  

 In this role, you will have the opportunity to review project requirements, communicate them accurately to the team, and ensure they are appropriately fulfilled. You will use your expertise to design and implement local and wide\-area network solutions, including IP and VOIP, that address customer requirements. You will also provide high\-quality technical solutions to our customers to prepare them for implementation, go\-live, and maintenance.
   

  

* Implement and manage branch side Switch \- VLANs, VTP, and trunking, Ensure network availability, performance, and security.
* Troubleshoot branch WAN issues using tools like ping, traceroute, and SNMP..
* Provide L1 support for branch networks, resolving hardware and software issues for Network devices.
* Ensure branch network devices are compliant with customer security policies.
* Participate in network upgrades, migrations, and projects.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve network\-related issues.
* Identify and resolve network\-related issues using logical troubleshooting methodologies.
* Analyse network logs, packet captures, and performance metrics, Escalate complex issues to senior engineers.


 If you are excited about using your technical expertise to create innovative network solutions and provide outstanding customer service, then this is the role for you!
   

  

 Your Future at Kyndryl
   

  

 At Kyndryl, we understand the importance of investing in our employees' professional growth and development. In Network Services, you can expect to receive a lot of support for training programs to keep your skills and knowledge up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge projects and contribute to the development of innovative solutions for our customers – including new wireless and 5G technologies – not yet adopted by most companies.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
   

  

 Required Technical and Professional Expertise
   

  

* 3 years of experience in Network support covering WAN technologies MPLS, SDWAN etc
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols (OSPF, EIGRP), and switching fundamentals.
* Experience with Cisco IOS and network management tools, Familiarity with WAN technologies (MPLS, VPNs).
* Monitor branch WAN links for availability, latency, and packet loss.
* Configure and troubleshoot network devices, including routers, switches, modems etc.
* Collaborate with telecom DC \& DRC teams to resolve branches WAN\-related issues
* Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot Cisco, Juniper, HP ant other OEM routers and switches.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* CCNP or equivalent certification.
* Experience with SDWAN, and VPNs.
* Familiarity with ITIL or similar service management frameworks.


**Being You**
 The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
   

  

**What You Can Expect**
 Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
   

  

 From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
   

  

 We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
   

  

 We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
   

  

**Get Referred!**
 If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

**Job Summary**
 Lubrizol is seeking a Network Delivery Engineer responsible for the end‑to‑end design, implementation, testing, and operational handover of enterprise network solutions. The role focuses on delivering secure, resilient, and scalable LAN, WAN, WLAN, Data Center, and Cloud connectivity in alignment with architectural standards, security policies, and service requirements. * Implement network security controls including firewall policies, VPNs, segmentation, and access management.
* Support security audits, vulnerability remediation, and major incident resolution.

**Additional Responsibilities**
* Analyze emerging technologies and propose improvements.
* Identify and mitigate network risks.
* Provide leadership and collaboration with Network Operations.
* 
* Troubleshoot high\-level network faults. Data center migration
* network scripting and programming/automation space including:

+ Python / Ansible / GIT
+ Linux

* Bachelor’s degree in IT or equivalent, with 8\+ years experience in global network environments.

* CCNP or higher.
* Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE.

**Other Requirements**
* Flexibility in work hours and travel.

Let’s build the future together.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
**The Company**
 Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
   

  

 We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
   

  

**Meet the team:** 
  

  

 Join a passionate team of engineers who are truly making a difference in the lives of people with diabetes. As a Systems Engineer at Dexcom India, you will act as a bridge between user needs and technical execution.
   

  

 We operate on a
 **"Full Stack" Systems Engineering model** 
 , meaning our engineers engage with the feature lifecycle end\-to\-end—from defining requirements to executing verification. We are a collaborative and innovative group dedicated to developing cutting\-edge mobile (Android/iOS) and medical device solutions that empower users to manage their health with confidence. If you are driven to make an impact and thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment, this is the team for you.
   

  

**Where You Come In**
* You will translate high\-level product vision, user needs, and transform them into detailed, testable technical requirements for our medical devices and associated mobile applications.
* You will create and maintain comprehensive System and Software Requirements Specifications (SRS), ensuring alignment with architecture and risk management frameworks.
* You will execute and manage requirements traceability using tools like Jama Connect, ensuring completeness, clarity, and consistency throughout the product lifecycle. You will generate and maintain verification trace matrices to demonstrate end\-to\-end coverage from requirements to test cases.
* You will collaborate with software, hardware, and test engineers to develop system and subsystem test strategies, plans, and test cases that validate all documented requirements.
* You will work closely with development and quality teams to resolve technical ambiguity and ensure the final product meets all clinical and user needs.
* You will apply Systems Engineering best practices throughout the product development lifecycle, ensuring rigorous adherence to internal SOPs and external standards.


**What Makes You Successful**
* Systems Thinking: You have a solid understanding of Systems Engineering principles, ideally with exposure to BLE architecture, mobile application development (Android/iOS), or embedded systems.
* Regulatory Knowledge: You have a working knowledge of (or a strong desire to learn) industry standards such as IEC 62304 (Medical Device Software) and ISO 14971 (Risk Management) and how to write requirements that support them.
* Tool Proficiency: You are comfortable using requirement management tools (e.g., Jama Connect) and familiar with software development and tracking tools like Jira, TestRail, and GitHub.
* Communication: You are an articulate communicator, able to convey technical information clearly to diverse audiences and collaborate effectively across time zones.
* Agility: You bring a proactive mindset and a passion for developing high\-quality, user\-centric products. You are adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


**Nice To Haves**
* INCOSE Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP) certification.
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond documentation generation, and advanced prompt engineering techniques.
* Proven track record of leading complex systems engineering projects from concept through to commercialization.

This includes managing Local Traffic Manager (LTM) for Server Load Balancing (SLB) and BIG\-IP DNS (formerly GTM) for Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB).

This role requires handling incidents, executing complex changes, and driving problem resolution within a strictly regulated environment adhering to security and compliance protocols.

* BE/B.Tech in Computer Science (CS) / Information Technology (IT), OR
* BCA/MCA, OR
* Master’s degree in CS/IT.


**Experience**
* L2 Role (Bhubaneswar): Minimum 5 years of relevant, hands\-on experience in network and load balancing operations.

**Mandatory Certifications**

* Core Security/Networking: CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker), CCNA, or CCNP (Routing \& Switching).

**Technical Skill Set**
* Load Balancing \& Traffic Management: Strong hands\-on experience with enterprise\-grade F5 BIG\-IP platforms, specifically LTM (Local Traffic Manager) and GTM/BIG\-IP DNS (Global Traffic Manager).
* Core Networking \& Routing: Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, and Routing \& Switching protocols (BGP, OSPF).
* Network Security: Proficient in SSL/TLS configuration, offloading, and managing secure VPNs.

**Key Responsibilities** 
**Incident \& Problem Management**
* Provide high\-tier support for all incidents and service requests related to DMZ SLBs and perimeter GSLBs.
* Analyze complex, multi\-layered incidents, identify root causes, and execute containment and remediation strategies.

**Operations \& Maintenance**

**Advanced Engineering (L3 Specific)**

 The Business Analyst will be the “single point of contact” for all data‑related issues raised by stakeholders across Capital Markets, Corporate Banking, Risk, Liquidity, and Referential Data.
   

  

**The Role Is Responsible For**
* Capturing and classifying issues in the central IMR register.
* Conducting deep‑dive root‑cause analysis (RCA) on large data sets.
* Driving remediation – coordinating with IT, business, and control owners to design systemic fixes, process changes, or new operational controls.
* Facilitating triage and resolution meetings, ensuring clear ownership, timely progress, and documented outcomes.
* Reporting status, trends, and remediation effectiveness to senior management and supporting continuous‑improvement initiatives.
* Automation – Drive process automation


**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

 Issue intake \& registration
   

  

* Log every incident in the IMR tool (JIRA), assign a severity rating, and ensure appropriate metadata (domain, regulator impact, etc.).


 Root\-cause analysis
   

  

* Analyse data using SQL (simple to medium\-complex queries).
* Perform quantitative checks, trend analysis, and data\-lineage reviews.
* Document findings in the “Issue Analysis” template.


 Stakeholder liaison
   

  

* Schedule and lead triage calls (30\-60 min) with business owners, data stewards, and risk analysts.
* Translate technical findings into business language and keep all parties updated on status.


 Remediation design
   

  

* Work with IT development, data engineering, and process owners to create one of three solutions:
* Systemic fix – code/ETL change.
* Process change – new SOP or data\-entry rule.
* Operational control – monitoring rule, data\-quality checkpoint.


 Implementation oversight
   

  

* Follow the build\-test\-deploy cycle, validate that the fix resolves the issue, and capture evidence (screenshots, test results).


 Closure \& reporting
   

  

* Prepare a “Remediation Summary” (root cause, solution, control mapping, verification evidence). Obtain sign\-off from the issue owner and risk/compliance signatory, then close the ticket and update the KPI dashboard (age, MTTR, repeat\-issue rate).


 Escalation \& governance
   

  

* Use the RAG\-matrix escalation process when an issue stalls; provide audit\-ready artefacts for internal/external reviews.


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* Have a continuous improvement mindset and look for removing waste and improving the process/task.
* Identify repeat\-issue patterns and propose enterprise\-wide enhancements (e.g., new data\-quality framework, automated validation scripts).
* Create/maintain SOPs, knowledge\-transfer documents, and cross\-training guides for the Data Office team.
* Contribute to the quarterly “Data\-Quality Status” report for senior management.
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards (nice\-to\-have) to visualize issue trends.
* Prepare presentations and status decks for leadership meetings.
* Participate in PMO activities – sprint planning, capacity tracking, and stakeholder communications.

* Intermediate SQL knowledge

title: Embedded System Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




 At Morphedo, Embedded Systems Engineers design and build the nervous system of mission\-critical devices. You will architect complete embedded solutions where hardware and firmware operate seamlessly under unpredictable, unforgiving conditions.
 



 From ICU wards with unstable electricity to high\-altitude defence outposts and aerospace deployments, your systems must function with precision, resilience, and compliance.
 



 This is not a narrow role. You will own the embedded stack end\-to\-end: PCB architecture, power systems, sensor integration, communication protocols, firmware development, validation, and regulatory alignment.
 



  





**Problem Statements You’ll Solve** 



* How can we design a portable medical device that delivers accurate diagnostics despite voltage fluctuations and EMI\-heavy environments?
* How do we build soldier\-worn embedded systems that guarantee 24/7 uptime in extreme temperature and pressure conditions?
* How can ultra\-low\-power IoT devices operate reliably for years in remote municipal infrastructure?
* How do we ensure seamless hardware–firmware synchronization while meeting ISO, IEC, and MIL\-STD requirements?
* How can we ruggedize embedded electronics without compromising performance, size, or energy efficiency?



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Embedded Hardware Architecture \& Design
 


* Design, prototype, and validate multi\-layer PCBs for embedded and IoT systems.
* Architect analog and digital subsystems including:
* Power management circuits
* Sensor front\-end circuits
* Communication interfaces
* Signal conditioning and filtering
* Select and qualify components for rugged, high\-reliability environments.
* Perform root\-cause analysis of hardware failures and implement corrective measures.
* Support EMI/EMC testing and certification processes.
* Drive hardware ruggedization for aerospace and defence deployments.



  





 2\. Embedded Firmware Development
 


* Develop real\-time firmware in C/C\+\+ for ARM\-based MCUs.
* Work with RTOS\-based architectures for deterministic, mission\-critical systems.
* Implement robust drivers for:
* I2C, SPI, UART, CAN
* BLE, LoRa, and other wireless protocols
* Optimize firmware for ultra\-low\-power performance.
* Conduct debugging, profiling, and system\-level validation.
* Ensure efficient memory and resource management in constrained environments.



  





 3\. Hardware–Firmware Integration
 


* Lead board bring\-up and hardware–firmware synchronization.
* Ensure signal integrity and accurate data acquisition.
* Validate sensor integration and communication robustness.
* Troubleshoot system\-level issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and spectrum analyzers.
* Collaborate closely with mechanical and industrial design teams for enclosure constraints and thermal management.



  





 4\. Testing, Validation \& Compliance
 


* Develop validation plans for embedded systems.
* Ensure compliance with:
* ISO and IEC standards (medical)
* EMC/EMI regulations
* MIL\-STD requirements (defence/aerospace)
* Maintain detailed documentation of design files, firmware revisions, testing procedures, and compliance records.
* Participate in certification support activities.



  





 5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& R\&D
 


* Work with AI/ML teams for sensor\-driven intelligence and edge processing.
* Support production and DFM (Design for Manufacturing) alignment.
* Contribute to feasibility studies and next\-gen R\&D proposals.
* Continuously evaluate emerging components, tools, and design methodologies.



  





 Required Qualifications
 


* B.Tech / M.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, or related field.
* 1\-4 years of hands\-on experience in embedded hardware and firmware development.
* Proficiency in:
* PCB design tools (Altium, Eagle, KiCAD)
* C/C\+\+ programming for embedded systems
* ARM\-based microcontrollers
* RTOS environments
* Strong understanding of:
* Communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, BLE, LoRa)
* Power management design
* EMI/EMC principles
* Low\-power system optimization
* Experience using debugging tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.



  





 Preferred Experience (Good to Have)
 


* Exposure to medical, aerospace, or defence\-grade systems.
* Experience in ruggedization techniques.
* Familiarity with certification workflows.
* Knowledge of secure boot, firmware encryption, or secure communication stacks.
* Experience with edge AI or sensor fusion systems.



  





 Culture \& Mindset
 


* Research\-driven engineer with strong curiosity for emerging technologies.
* Detail\-obsessed with a quality\-first mindset.
* Resilient in long R\&D cycles with high uncertainty.
* Strong ownership mindset with accountability for complete system performance.
* Collaborative and aligned with a “solve for Bharat” mission.



  





 Why Join Morphedo?
 


* Work on next\-generation deep\-tech innovations across aerospace, defence, medical, and energy domains.
* Architect real\-world mission systems, not just prototypes.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a cutting\-edge R\&D ecosystem.
* Build products that directly impact healthcare, national security, and infrastructure.
* Accelerate your growth in a fast\-scaling deep\-tech company.

title: Embedded Firmware Development Engineer
description:
Embedded Firmware Development Engineer
 



 Job Description: Embedded Firmware Engineer – AC\-DC / DC\-DC Power Converters (P21\)
 



 Role Summary
 



 The Firmware or Embedded Software is responsible for developing, implementing, and validating embedded control software for AC\-DC rectifiers, DC\-DC converters, on\-board/off\-board chargers, SMPS, and power conversion systems.
 



 The role focuses on control algorithms, digital control loop development, real\-time firmware, protection logic, communication protocols, and hardware bring\-up. End to end responsibility of firmware development and functionality.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Embedded Firmware Development
 



 Develop low\-level firmware for digital controllers
 



 TI C2000 (F2803x, F2837x, F28004x, F28x series), ARM Cortex\-M microcontrollers, DSP/FPGA
 



 Implement control loops for AC\-DC and DC\-DC conversion such as Current loop, voltage loop, PFC control (totem Poly, CCM, interleaved), LLC/DC\-DC stage control, Soft\-start, mode transition, burst modes
 



 Develop firmware for PWM generation, ADC sampling, interrupts, timers.
 



 2\. Converter Control Algorithms
 


* Design, tune, and validate algorithms for AC\-DC PFC control (average, peak, digital), DC\-DC resonant/LLC control,– Phase\-shifted full bridge, Buck/Boost control, multi\-phase interleaving
* Implement digital compensators (PI, PID, feed\-forward, PR, PLL).



 3\. Protection \& Safety Logic
 


* Develop firmware for protections OVP/UVP, OCP, SCP, Over\-temperature, Soft\-switching protection, Input/output surge and transient protections
* Implement fast fault detection and safe shutdown algorithms.



 4\. Hardware Bring\-up \& Validation
 


* Work with hardware engineers to validate Gate drivers, Power stage behaviour, ADC sensing circuits, Board bring\-up and debugging
* Perform real\-time testing using oscilloscope, power analyser, logic analyser.



 5\. Digital Communication \& Interfaces
 


* Should implement the following protocol CAN / CAN open /1939/Modbus/RS485/Ethernet/UART/SPI/ I2C
* Should Integrate firmware with cloud/BMS/controllers if required.



 6\. System Integration \& Optimization
 



 Ensure firmware meets requirements for Efficiency, Dynamic response, EMI/EMC, compliance, Start\-up/shutdown sequencing, Optimize real\-time control code for performance and safety.
 



 7\. Documentation
 



 Prepare firmware architecture, Requirements \& design specifications, Test cases \& validation reports, Version control
 



 Technical Skills
 


* Strong understanding of power electronics control
* Experience in AC\-DC and DC\-DC converter control firmware.
* Hands\-on with real\-time embedded programming (C, C\+\+).
* Experience with digital control libraries (TI DCL, CMSIS DSP).
* Understanding of PWM modules, ADC sampling, control timing.
* Good debugging skills on real hardware.



 Tools
 


* Code Composer Studio (TI), Keil, IAR, STM32Cube.
* MATLAB/Simulink (algorithm simulation).
* Git, JIRA, SVN.



 Qualifications
 



 B.E / B.Tech / M.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, Power Electronics.
 



 Experience 2\-8 Years
 







 Preferred Experience
 



 Worked on 30\+ kW\-level converters for EV chargers, ESS, solar inverters, onboard chargers.
 



 Knowledge of automotive ISO 26262, IEC 61800, IEC 61000 standards (preferred).
 



 Exposure to SiC/GaN based systems. Experience with FPGA or RTOS is a plus.

**Role Type:** Individual Contributor  

**Industry:** Medical Devices / Healthcare / Life Sciences Manufacturing

**About the Role**


We are looking for an experienced Compensation \& Benefits professional to join our client on an interim assignment for 6–8 months. This role will be responsible for driving end\-to\-end payroll governance, compensation operations, statutory compliance coordination, reporting, audits, and employee compensation support in partnership with an external payroll service provider and internal stakeholders.


The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in payroll operations, compensation administration, statutory processes, reporting, reconciliations, and financial accuracy, as well as the ability to independently manage multiple stakeholders in a fast\-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Payroll \& Compensation Operations**

* Manage end\-to\-end payroll coordination with the third\-party payroll vendor.
* Validate monthly payroll inputs and ensure timely and accurate payroll processing.
* Conduct payroll validation, salary variance analysis, and net pay variance checks.
* Perform final payroll audits and ensure payroll accuracy before salary disbursement.
* Manage bank transfer validation, transfer advice, and bank file uploads on banking portals.
* Coordinate payroll\-related statutory compliance payments and timelines.
* Support payroll processing for interns and consultants.
* Handle employee compensation and payroll\-related queries effectively.

**Compensation Administration**

* Prepare and manage offer letters and increment letters.
* Support salary revisions, compensation structures, and related documentation.
* Manage reimbursement payments and lease\-related payments.
* Prepare salary provisions and salary journal vouchers (JV).
* Coordinate salary JV entries in SAP.

**Reporting, Reconciliation \& Compliance**

* Prepare MIS reports for HR and leadership stakeholders.
* Conduct monthly headcount reconciliations.
* Support quarterly activities including:


	+ Inventory loading data
	+ Audit schedules
	+ Cross\-charge reconciliations
	+ Gratuity valuation
	+ Leave provision calculations
* Support annual operating planning (AOP) activities related to compensation and manpower budgeting.
* Ensure proper documentation, audit readiness, and process compliance.

**Key Requirements**

* 8–15\+ years of experience in Compensation \& Benefits, Payroll Operations, or HR Shared Services.
* Strong expertise in payroll governance and vendor\-managed payroll environments.
* Experience handling payroll audits, reconciliations, salary variances, and statutory compliance coordination.
* Hands\-on exposure to SAP and payroll systems.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently in an individual contributor setup.
* High attention to detail and strong process orientation.
* Prior experience in manufacturing, healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical devices, or similar regulated industries will be preferred.

title: Workday Data Migration, Conversion and Mapping Analyst
description:
Job title: Workday Data Migration, Conversion and Mapping Analyst


Job location: Hyderabad, Hub


Job type: Fulltime/Permanent


About Sanofi


At Sanofi, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. As a global healthcare leader, we are committed to transforming the practice of medicine by pursuing breakthrough science, building sustainable business models, and expanding access to our medicines and vaccines. Our people are at the heart of everything we do — and so is the data that powers our operations.

**About the job**


The Opportunity


This is an exciting opportunity to further develop your career in data migration and Workday by joining a newly created Data Migration team at a pivotal moment. With 80% involvement in complex global projects — including implementations, data migrations, reporting and visualization initiatives, data sharing agreements, and data foundation developments — this role will support mission\-critical data mapping and loading activities that directly impact business operations, M\&A success, and compliance.


You will work under the Data Migration and Conversion Lead and have an expertise in Workday and EiB loads.


Key Responsibilities


Data Mapping Support

* Assist in building and maintaining source\-to\-Workday field mappings for loads
* Support documentation of transformation logic, validation rules, and value conversions
* Learn and apply country\-specific data standardization approaches
* Support mapping activities under the guidance of senior analysts


Bulk Load Execution Support

* Assist in executing Workday bulk loads using EIB and approved tools
* Support design and validation of templates, sequencing, and dependencies
* Prepare loads for review by senior analysts
* Follow approved governance processes and standards at all times


Migration Delivery Support

* Support end\-to\-end migration execution including mock loads, reconciliations, and production loads
* Assist in maintaining migration playbooks and cutover plans
* Support test load execution and result validation
* Assist in reconciliations between source and target systems


M\&A Support

* Assist in assessing and mapping incoming HR data for acquisitions
* Support cleansing, transformation, and loading activities for acquired populations
* Support data extraction and separation activities for divestitures
* Contribute to Day 1 readiness preparation for employee data in Workday


Data Quality Assurance

* Perform basic pre\-load data quality checks
* Identify and escalate data quality issues to senior analysts
* Support Data Governance and Data Quality teams on remediation activities
* Assist in guarding the People Data Model via correct data preparation


Documentation \& Audit Support

* Assist in maintaining audit trails, reconciliation reports, and rollback procedures
* Support load documentation maintenance and compliance
* Assist with audit and compliance requirements

**About you**


Required Qualifications

* Education \& Experience: Bachelor's degree in information systems, Data Management, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field
* 2\-5 years of experience in data management, data analysis, or related roles
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Workday EiB and HCM Certified
* Experience working in team environments


Technical Skills

* Strong Python, Excel and data automation and manipulation skills required
* Worked with Informatica or other ETL tools
* Basic SQL knowledge would be beneficial
* Workday HCM knowledge and EiB load preparation and execution
* Understanding of data concepts and data quality principles
* Comfortable learning new technical tools and systems


Soft Skills \& Behaviours

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Strong communication and documentation skills
* Ability to follow processes and procedures consistently
* Proactive approach to learning and professional development
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Collaborative mindset with willingness to support team members


Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with data analysis or data quality and conversio tools
* Strong understanding of Workday and EiB Loads
* Workday Certification: EiB Manager and HCM
* Knowledge of data governance principles
* Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry
* Familiarity with process documentation and standard operating procedures
* Exposure to project management or Agile methodologies


What Success Looks Like

* Accurate completion of assigned data mapping and load preparation tasks
* Successful support of bulk load execution with minimal errors in Workday
* Consistent adherence to data quality standards and governance processes
* Timely completion of assigned migration activities within project timelines
* Accurate and complete documentation of all work performed
* Proactive identification and escalation of data quality issues
* Strong collaboration with other analysts and team members
* Continuous learning and skill development in Workday and data migration
* Meaningful contribution to successful M\&A integrations and data migrations


Why Join Sanofi?

* **Join a newly created team** with significant impact on global operations from day one
* **Work on mission\-critical projects** — M\&A integrations, global data migrations, and organizational transformations
* **Develop in\-demand expertise** in Workday and complex data environments
* **Collaborate globally** with stakeholders across Sanofi's worldwide operations
* **Contribute to Sanofi's mission** to improve patients' lives through operational excellence
* **Competitive compensation** and comprehensive benefits package
* **Dynamic, innovative environment** with real opportunities for career advancement

title: Assistant HR IT Manager - Global Mobility
description:
**Job Title:** **Assistant HR IT Manager \- Global Mobility**

**Location: Bangalore**

**ABOUT UNILEVER:**


Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose\-led business. Work with brands that are well\-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future.


Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you’ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you’ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you.

**ABOUT BANGALORE HUB:**


Bangalore Hub is the global technology and operations engine of Unilever offering business services, technology, and enterprise solutions. Bangalore Hub serves over 190 locations and through a network of specialized service lines and partners delivers insights and innovations, user experiences and end\-to\-end seamless delivery making Unilever Purpose Led and Future Fit.

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**


We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-oriented Global Mobility Technology partner to join our team and play a key role in transforming our Global mobility processes into digital solutions. You will work closely with the HR, PEX teams at our global locations to understand their needs and challenges and then collaborate with the technology teams within HR IT and broader Unilever IT to design and implement innovative digital solutions that streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance employee experience.


This role will be responsible for the overall administration of Global mobility technology platform(s) for international assignees and expat payroll, managing enterprise\-wide design framework, implementation of updates brought about by periodic releases and changes required by the users in the Equus AssignmentPro or other Global mobility systems.


This also includes maintaining standards, impact assessment and solution recommendation. The HR IT business partner for Global mobility serves as Subject Matter Expert on Equus AssignmentPro and will provide support to any related modules and downstream systems.

**WHAT WILL YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES BE**

* First point of contact for Global and regional HR team and UL vendors for new demands, change request or any support requirement for Global Mobility
* Setting up, configuring, and maintaining all objects related to Global Mobility in AssignmentPro. Establishing and maintaining tenant wide standards on managing objects related to global mobility.
* Ensures accuracy of global mobility setup to sustain integrity of Equus AssignmentPro as single source of truth system and support sustenance of data flow to other linked platforms
* Captures, reviews \& act upon, including testing \& assessing impact of periodic releases related to global mobility technologies
* Liaises with Global Process Owners on change impact
* Sets key performance indicators of the team and ensures that key responsibility areas are managed efficiently and excellently
* Actively works and supports resolution of issues escalated, managing incidents, tracking ticket status and partnering with support teams to resolve
* Identifies and recommends processes areas that could be simplified, improved or changed; to enhance user experience and drive simplification
* Provides support in maintaining training activities and materials, including user guides, FAQ, recorded demos, portal content, etc.
* Plans projects that address business needs, and assess fit of new global mobility applications and vendors
* Support all global mobility integrations for any new demand, change request or trouble shooting
* Impact Assessment on payroll and rewards for any changes in AssignmentPro or any related application
* Liaises between HR and IT teams and supports HR business during project and BAU
* Ensures requirements and test plans are signed off in projects
* Ensures requirements by HR and IT are understood by both parties before any change or project
* Takes up IT project management role if there is no dedicated project manager in projects
* Works with HR team for user acceptance testing and ensure stakeholders are ready for go\-live
* Works on various KRAs for global mobility programs
* Assess global mobility processes and suggests automation opportunities
* Ensures that new vendors meet local and global Unilever standards and strategy.
* Supports business in vendor transitions.
* Implements new global mobility integration projects between global mobility technology platforms such as AssignmentPro and various systems such as Workday and Payroll systems
* Works with Data Privacy Team, Vendor Risk Management team and Cybersecurity team to ensure that new projects meet company standards
* Works with Enterprise Architecture to ensure that new projects are aligned with global technology strategy

**EXPERIENCES \& QUALIFICATIONS**

*Necessary Experience \& Qualifications*

* Education: A bachelor’s degree in information technology, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* Experience: 7\+ years of overall experience in HR technologies
* Technical Skills: 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Equus AssignmentPro. Payroll experience is good to have.
* Project Management: Project management experience, including the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

*Preferred Experience \& Qualifications*

* Project Management: Experience managing timelines, deliverables, and coordinating multiple work streams is beneficial.
* Knowledge of agile methodologies and experience working in agile environments.
* Knowledge of AssignmentPro and other HR systems in the domain of Global Mobility and payroll
* Strong knowledge of end\-to\-end Global Mobility HR processes, payroll, compensation and benefits and ability to define dependencies and connect the dots across the technology landscape.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Outstanding analytical, problem solving and fact\-finding skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate solution design, design proposals and negotiate options with stakeholders
* Ability to understand the HR’s business problem, need, or opportunity and to design a solution that completely and correctly addresses the need.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
* Ability to identify, clarify and resolve project issues and risks as needed.
* Strong relationship building skills to effectively partner with HR CoEs and other internal teams and external vendors.
* Ability to manage time and resources efficiently and effectively.
* Ability to work independently.

**SKILLS**

* Equus Assignment Pro
* International Assignments
* Expat Payroll
* Change Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Strategic Thinking
* Collaboration
* Customer Centricity
* Data Driven Decision making
* Digital Technology awareness
* Product Delivery
* Project Management

**LEADERSHIP SKILLS**

* **Unilever Behaviors** \[highlight the 2 most important for this role]


	+ **PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE:** Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results. Generates intensity and focus to motivate people to deliver results at speed.
	+ **PERSONAL MASTERY:** Sets high standards for themselves. Actively builds own wellbeing and resilience.
	+ **TALENT CATALYST:** Invests in people – coaches individuals and teams to realize their full potential. Creates an inclusive climate, empowering everyone to be at their best. Inspires powerful teamwork and collaboration, connecting people for better results.
	+ **CONSUMER LOVE:** Brings the voice of the consumer into everything we do, always.
	+ **BUSINESS ACUMEN**: Creates opportunities for profitable growth through the core and beyond.


At HUL, we believe that every individual irrespective of their race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, nationality, caste, disability or marital status can bring their purpose to life. So apply to us, to unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make the world a better place. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you!

**Note:** *"All official offers from Unilever are issued only via our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Offers from individuals or unofficial sources may be fraudulent—please verify before proceeding."*

title: Sr Manager L D
description:
As a Sr. Manager for L\&D, you will be responsible for rolling out learning and development interventions that create business impact and drive growth for the organization. The learning ecosystem focuses not only on classroom driven learning interventions but also on peer\-to\-peer knowledge sharing/learning, self\-paced online learning programs, social learning, hackathons, learning through curated resources etc. You will get an opportunity to lead multiple, cross functional teams to help with building the relevant learning solutions across various modalities for the organization.


Key Role and Responsibilities:


* Learning Strategy: Plays a key leadership role in arriving at a learning strategy and priorities for L\&D and the client groups. This will include building a talent pool with deeper capabilities and skill sets to help drive business results more effectively. Ensures strong delivery of strategy with measurable outcomes.
* Consulting: Conducts strong needs analysis to then design and develop new (and update existing) learning and training interventions and curriculum based on organizational changes, system changes/updates, and client feedback. Consults on learning and development initiatives that have organization\-wide impact. Ensures strong delivery to goals set out. Facilitate delivery of learning curriculum and initiatives in identified areas.
* Supervision and Development: Leads and develops large teams across various business units. Ensures learning interventions are meeting client expectations with the relevant organizational impact. Coaches and supports the team for development and for performance. Ensures all projects and milestones are achieved in a timely manner with the best measurable outcomes. Obtains necessary resources for the team’s success.

* Partnerships: Ensures collaborative partnerships with clients, Team HR, Target HQ and support groups.
* Process and Measurements\- Create \& roll out processes to promote and measure learning. Monitor and evaluate the learning interventions, programs, metrics, adoption, coverage and share back to drive efficiency within team and with clients.
* Budget: Manages budget; monitors spending on a monthly basis; ensures expenditures are in line with plan.
* Other: Manages multiple large\-scale projects on an as\-needed basis


We’ll support you along the way with robust onboarding, as well as personal and career development, to help you grow as a strong L\&D professional. The exciting part of retail? It’s always changing! Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs*.*
